description_html:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

This is our first Director of Employee Relations & Compliance for EMEA: a senior, hands-on role owning ER casework, employment law compliance and jurisdictional risk across Germany, the UK, Sweden, Italy, Spain and France.

Based in London, you'll be the standing authority on ER practice in the region. You'll own complex casework end to end, build dedicated ER capability where none exists today, and extend the strength we already have in Stockholm. You'll report to the EMEA People Director, with a path to running an independent function reporting to the CHRO as it scales.

What You'll Do

ER leadership and casework

  • Own complex casework end to end across every market: investigations, grievances, disciplinaries, PIPs and terminations for cause, to a consistently high, legally sound standard.

  • Be the escalation point when a matter turns complex, contested or legally weighted, for Local People Advisory and the wider People org.

  • Hold the bar on case handling: written scoping, contemporaneous documentation, balance-of-probabilities findings, and independent second review of any outcome that could end employment.

Compliance and jurisdictional risk

  • Own employment and ER compliance across all six markets: statutory notice and consultation, works council and union engagement, mandatory filings and register-keeping, and local implementation of the EU Whistleblowing Directive (disclosures run through a separate channel).

  • Maintain the EMEA jurisdiction playbook and horizon-scan for legal changes, flagging implications to leadership early.

  • Engage Employment Counsel at the right moment with a clear written scope, not as a late rescue.

  • Note: comp-related compliance (pay equity, gender pay gap, benefits) sits with Rewards.

Team and capability building

  • Build dedicated ER capability across EMEA, prioritised by risk and case volume, on the foundation of the Stockholm team.

  • Certify and calibrate anyone running a formal ER process, keeping casework consistent as the team grows.

Stakeholder partnership and consistency

  • Act as the quality check for Local People Advisory across EMEA (who sit in People Operations), signing off local ER and compliance work without managing those roles day to day.

  • Partner with People Partners, People Operations, People Tech and Rewards so policy and tooling reflect what EMEA markets need.

  • Turn case patterns into a regular, actionable view for People leadership.

  • Work with your NORAM and APAC counterparts on one shared case taxonomy, system and calibration forum, representing EMEA's regulatory and cultural nuance in global standards.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience leading ER, HR compliance or similar at a fast-scaling company, ideally across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.

  • Deep, practical knowledge of employment law and ER practice across several of these markets, and comfort working outside your home jurisdiction.

  • A track record of investigations, disciplinaries and terminations that hold up to scrutiny: calm, neutral and thorough under pressure.

  • Experience building an ER or compliance function from the ground up: process, hiring, and getting a distributed team to one standard.

  • Confidence as a senior, independent voice, comfortable escalating to and influencing leadership.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to London, able to travel across EMEA.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every formal ER matter across the region handled fairly, consistently and to a legally sound standard.

  • A resourced, capable EMEA ER team, built out from London to the markets that need it.

  • The wider People org treats this function as the standing authority on ER and compliance, not a bottleneck.

  • A function ready to stand on its own, with a credible case for direct CHRO reporting.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

About the role

Legal work is being reshaped by AI faster than most firms can measure. Our AI Transformation & Applied Behavioural Research function exists to close that gap: we study how lawyers and legal teams actually adopt, trust, and build skill with AI, and we turn that evidence into changes across our product, customer enablement, and go-to-market motion.

As an Applied Behavioural Researcher on the team, you will bring rigor to how we measure adoption and capability growth, not just usage. You'll design the studies, build the instruments, and work the data yourself, then translate what you find into recommendations that product, customer success, and leadership can act on. This is a hands-on, mid-level role for someone who wants to do the analysis personally rather than only oversee it, while still being trusted to shape what we study next.

You'll sit close to real legal teams and real deployments, so the questions you're answering are grounded in what's actually happening in firms today, not hypothetical adoption curves.

Responsibilities

  • Design and run mixed-methods studies on how lawyers and legal professionals build real proficiency with AI tools, distinguishing genuine capability growth from surface-level usage.

  • Build and validate the surveys, interview protocols, and quantitative measures the team relies on, so findings hold up to scrutiny from product, customer, and executive stakeholders.

  • Analyze usage and outcome data directly, using standard research tooling, to surface patterns in how adoption succeeds or stalls across different firms and practice areas.

  • Translate research findings into concrete recommendations for product features, onboarding, and customer enablement programs, working closely with product managers, customer success, and engineering.

About Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the AI platform for in-house legal teams. Our customers use Wordsmith to move faster, automate the repetitive parts of legal work, and give their whole business quicker access to legal support. We're growing quickly, and every new customer we win deserves a brilliant experience from day one — that's where you come in.

About the role

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to be the hands-on, day-to-day champion for our customers. This is not a quota-carrying role. Your job is to make customers successful: get them onboarded quickly, answer their questions, keep our shared inbox humming, and continually drive adoption of the product across their teams.

It's an early-career role with real responsibility from week one. You'll work directly with customers every day and see the direct connection between the work you do and the value they get — and, in turn, the revenue they retain and grow with us.

What you'll do

  • Onboard new customers and new business — run the enablement process that takes a freshly signed customer from kick-off to confident, active use of Wordsmith.

  • Answer customer support questions — be the first, friendly, fast response when customers need help, and see every question through to resolution.

  • Manage the shared customer inbox — own it end to end: triage, respond, route, and make sure nothing slips through the cracks.

  • Drive product adoption, constantly — spot dormant users and under-used features, run training sessions, share best practice, and turn every account into an engaged, healthy one.

  • Be the voice of the customer — feed what you hear back to the product and commercial teams so we build and sell the right things.

What we're looking for

  • 0–2 years of experience — in customer success, support, account management, hospitality, or any role where you looked after people. Recent graduates welcome.

  • Super hands-on with customers — you roll up your sleeves, get on the call, write the doc, chase the answer. You'd rather fix it than file it.

  • Commercially minded — you don't carry a quota (retention), but you understand why adoption matters: engaged customers renew, grow, and become advocates. You connect your daily work to that outcome.

  • A clear, warm communicator — comfortable writing and speaking with customers all day, and able to make technical things feel simple.

  • Organised and reliable — you can juggle an inbox, a training schedule, and a list of follow-ups without dropping any of them.

  • Curious about AI and legal tech — you don't need a legal background, but you're excited to learn the product deeply and become a genuine expert in it.

Why Wordsmith

  • Ground-floor seat at a fast-growing AI company, with a front-row view of how modern legal teams adopt AI.

title: Support Engineer

description_html:
Support Engineer

Edinburgh

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The role

We’re hiring a Support Engineer to provide fast, thoughtful and technically rigorous help to Wordsmith customers.

You’ll own technical questions and incidents from first response through to resolution. You’ll understand what the customer is trying to achieve, reproduce reported behaviour, investigate the underlying cause and explain the outcome clearly.

This is more than scripted customer support. You’ll be expected to investigate application behaviour at a technical level, including reading logs and tracing issues through the product and its codebase. Where appropriate to your experience, you may also propose and submit code fixes through our normal engineering review and release process.

Wordsmith supports customers globally through a follow-the-sun model. You’ll work the standard hours for your region and hand over unresolved issues clearly to colleagues in other regions. There is no routine expectation that you work another region’s hours.

What you’ll do

  • Own technical support requests — triage, investigate and resolve customer questions and incidents from first response to confirmed resolution.

  • Diagnose problems thoroughly — gather the right context, reproduce reported behaviour, inspect logs and data, and trace issues through the product and codebase.

  • Resolve technical issues — correct configuration or usage problems directly and collaborate with Engineering when a product or infrastructure change is required.

  • Contribute code fixes where appropriate — depending on your experience, propose and submit well-tested fixes through the standard engineering review and deployment process.

  • Communicate clearly — give customers timely and accurate updates, explain technical issues without unnecessary jargon and set honest expectations.

  • Manage escalations — bring in Engineering, Product or other specialists when needed while retaining ownership of the case and its communication.

  • Support global handovers — document investigation, impact, current status and next actions so colleagues in another region can continue work without losing momentum.

  • Protect service quality — recognise high-impact incidents quickly, follow the appropriate escalation process and contribute to incident reviews.

  • Build customer knowledge — create and maintain troubleshooting guides, known-issue documentation and help-centre content.

  • Reduce repeat problems — identify patterns in support demand and recommend improvements to the product, documentation, tooling and customer experience.

  • Improve support operations — help develop service levels, escalation paths, reporting and technical-support processes as the function scales.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in technical support, product support, software engineering, solutions engineering or another customer-facing technical role.

  • Strong diagnostic ability — you can work methodically from symptoms to root cause rather than relying on guesswork.

  • A working understanding of modern web applications, APIs, authentication, integrations and common browser or network issues.

  • Experience using diagnostic information such as application logs, monitoring tools, browser developer tools and database queries.

  • Enough familiarity with software code to navigate a codebase, follow application logic and use it to investigate reported behaviour.

  • Clear customer communication — you can remain calm under pressure, set expectations honestly and explain complex issues at the right level of detail.

  • Strong ownership — you remain responsible for moving an issue forward even when other teams need to contribute.

  • Sound prioritisation — you can assess urgency and customer impact and recognise when an issue requires immediate escalation.

  • Care and precision — you document what you tested, avoid unsupported conclusions and confirm that the customer’s problem has actually been resolved.

  • Interest in AI systems — you’re curious about how AI-enabled products behave and comfortable investigating issues that may not always be deterministic.

  • No legal background is required, but you should be motivated to learn how in-house legal teams work.

Desirable, but not essential

  • Experience writing and debugging production software.

  • The ability to create automated tests and submit code fixes for engineering review.

  • Experience supporting AI-enabled or data-intensive applications.

  • Familiarity with incident-management and observability tools.

How we work

We’re an in-person team based in Edinburgh. You should expect to work from the office as your default.

We support customers globally using a follow-the-sun model. You’ll work the normal hours agreed for your region and create clear handovers when an issue needs to continue beyond them. Any exceptional on-call or out-of-hours arrangements would be agreed and communicated separately.

We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. Support is a core part of the product experience, and we expect it to be technically credible, responsive and human.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Transformation and Customer Success. Customer Success owns adoption and customer health; Transformation owns implementation; Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth; and Support Engineering owns technical investigation and resolution.

Why Wordsmith

You’ll support a fast-growing product used for important work inside some of the world’s most ambitious organisations.

Because we’re building in a new technical category, the problems are interesting. You’ll work across software behaviour, integrations, data and AI systems rather than following a script.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape our support tooling and operating model, influence the product through direct customer evidence, and develop towards senior support engineering, support leadership, solutions engineering or product engineering.

title: Sales Operations Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Relay
description_html:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

About the Role

Relay sells through two core motions. The first is our new-business engine: a B2B enterprise sales motion winning large retailers and brands with significant parcel volumes — and, in time, extending down-market into Small medium enterprises (SME) as that segment opens up. The second is our field engine, which grows Relay's network of "Pitstops" — local shops and businesses that act as pick-up and drop-off points where consumers can collect parcels and return items.

Both motions depend on the systems and processes this role will build and own: the account universe and TAM, lead scoring and prioritisation, outreach, CRM architecture, governance, and sales tooling.

You'll be both architect and operator, and AI-native in how you work. You'll define what great looks like across the systems and processes underpinning both sales motions, then take ownership of making it happen. You’ll also be highly fluent in metrics — using dashboards and funnel data to identify where performance is breaking down, where opportunities are being lost, and where we can drive greater efficiency.

What You'll Do

  • Build the new-business engine: own TAM, account scoring and weekly prioritisation, plus a top-of-funnel (enrichment, multi-threaded contacts, sequencing, signal-based triggers) that lets sales spend their time pitching, not hunting.

  • Own the CRM and deal desk: architect Pipedrive around the selling rhythm, govern deal terms, stages and approval gates from pitch to activation, and raise the quality and speed of pitches and proposals.

  • Scale the Pitstop engine: run the field team's scoring, territories, targets and dashboards, manage pricing levers and CPA, and keep lead-to-live data clean, pushing toward a self-running engine with algorithmic assignment, referrals and AI-handled inbound.

  • Automate relentlessly: own the tooling stack and build-vs-buy calls (defaulting to building), strip manual work out of the sales day, and design systems that extend to SME and self-serve through configuration, not a rebuild.

  • Diagnose and fix the funnel: use funnel data to find where deals stall and pipeline leaks, then ship the fixes.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

  • Systems thinker. You build systems rather than one-off fixes, and you take ideas all the way to a shipped, working solution yourself.

  • Proven RevOps experience. You've run sales or revenue operations in a fast-moving environment and know what best-in-class looks like across top-of-funnel, CRM, deal desk and process.

  • CRM owner, not just admin. You've implemented and evolved Pipedrive (or similar) so it fits the selling motion, rather than bending the motion to fit the tool.

  • Native AI builder. You're fluent with Claude and have shipped real tooling and automations in a live business.

  • Fast, practical delivery. You implement quickly and are comfortable scoping work for engineering when you need their help.

  • High bar for quality. You insist on clean data and tight processes

  • Equally strong in detail and with people. You're comfortable refining a workflow in depth and equally at ease talking pipeline quality with sales.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Hardware of your choice

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more)

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

About the role

Relay's network runs on forecasts. Every shift released in sortation, every middle-mile van dispatched, every last-mile route planned, every expansion decision made - all downstream of models that predict how parcels move through our system. When those models are right, the network runs efficiently and cost per parcel drops. When they drift, the cost compounds across every stage of the operation. The Network squad builds and maintains the forecasting engine that powers all of it, and Demand Forecasting is its core: one forecast of what will be available to sort, at outcode granularity, from D0 out to D30.

As a Staff Data Scientist, you are the technical anchor for Demand Forecasting. You own the hardest and most ambiguous parts of the forecast, and you set the methodology and validation standards the rest of the area works to. That means owning the single integrated forecast of what volume the network will have to move, by area and out to thirty days, which the demand-management layer then turns into the operational plan the sort centres and transport teams run on. It means owning the model-driven end of that forecast, where the horizon runs past any live tracking data and expected parcels have to be generated from models rather than observed. It means owning the forecast of inbound international volume, one of the hardest prediction problems we have. And it means owning the models that predict each parcel's size and weight, which turn a parcel count into the physical volume that actually has to be sorted and loaded.

This is a hands-on role. You will spend most of your time building, not managing. You set the direction for how Demand Forecasting models, evaluates and ships its work, and you raise the technical bar across the area, but you do it as the most senior individual contributor in the room, on the tools. You'll work alongside a Senior Data Scientist who owns the domestic volume forecasts, an ML Engineer who keeps the models running reliably in production, and an Analyst who owns forecast accuracy and data quality. People leadership, strategy and cross-squad priorities sit with the Data Science Manager who leads the squad; you own the science.

Relay operates a centralised data team of around 30 Data Engineers, Analysts, and Data Scientists, with specialists embedded into squads across the business. You will sit in the Network squad and report into the centralised data team. Demand Forecasting is growing, and as its Staff DS you will have the deciding voice on its technical direction and the modelling approaches it adopts.

What You'll Do

  • Own the integrated forecast end to end. Blend live tracking signals in the near term with model-generated parcels further out into a single view, by area, from today to thirty days ahead. This is the view the demand-management layer turns into the plan that Sortation, Middle Mile and Last Mile actually run on.

  • Build the hardest models in the area. The model-generated long-horizon forecast, the inbound-international volume forecast, and the parcel size and weight models that make the forecast a measure of physical volume rather than just a count. These are the ambiguous, high-leverage problems, and they are yours.

  • Set the methodology and validation standards for Demand Forecasting. Define how models are evaluated, how accuracy is measured at each horizon (a forecast made thirty days out shouldn't be held to the standard of one made two days out), and what "good" looks like across the area's models.

  • Raise the technical bar. Review approaches, make the model-choice and build-vs-buy calls, and mentor the Senior Data Scientist and Analyst alongside you, without taking on their line management.

  • Define the forecast's interfaces. Decide what Demand Forecasting hands to the demand-management layer, to Routing, and to the network-planning function: at what granularity, with what guarantees, and how error is attributed when a number turns out wrong.

  • Learn the operational processes your models serve, supported by the squad and the teams who use the forecasts, and identify where the current approach falls short.

  • Own production quality across the estate, working with the ML Engineer so that models are monitored, drift is caught early, and accuracy problems are traced to the right cause rather than re-tuned blindly.

  • Work with Finance, who extend the operational forecasts into longer-range financial projections, to keep the handoff between operational and financial models reliable.

  • Quantify the impact of model error on cost per parcel, and use it to decide where the area invests effort.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

You have been the technical anchor on a modelling team before. You've owned the hardest problems, set the standards others worked to, and been the person the team turned to when an approach needed a call. You did it hands-on, as a senior IC, not by moving into management, and that's the path you want to keep on.

You think in interconnected systems. A demand forecast isn't just a number; it drives how many shifts are opened, how many vans are dispatched and how routes are planned, and it feeds a downstream planning decision and the network's expansion models. You care about how your models connect to the models around them, and you design their interfaces deliberately.

A deep track record of building and delivering models from ambiguous starting points. You understand the problem, build something useful, validate it against real operations, and iterate. You evaluate models well beyond standard offline metrics, connecting outputs to downstream applications and business KPIs and measuring how improvements translate into operational impact.

Strong Python and SQL, and depth across the full modelling lifecycle - from data extraction and feature engineering through training, validation and production deployment. You've worked with time-series forecasting across classical statistical approaches, gradient boosting and deep learning, and you understand the trade-offs well enough to make and defend the choice for a given problem. You'll be supported by a dedicated ML Engineer, but you set the standard for how the area's models are built.

At least 8 years in a data science or quantitative modelling role, with clear examples of models you built that informed operational or commercial decisions, and of methodology or technical direction you set for a team. You know a model isn't done when it trains well; it's done when it's running, monitored, and trusted.

You communicate with non-technical stakeholders with authority. The squads that consume the forecasts need to trust them, and that trust comes from explaining what the models do, where they're reliable, and where they're not, without hiding behind the maths.

You're comfortable using AI tools - LLMs, code assistants, and similar - to accelerate your workflow, from exploratory analysis to code generation, and you're curious about where these tools can augment the modelling process itself.

This role suits someone who wants to see whether their models made a real difference to how the network operates. There is a direct feedback loop between your work and operational outcomes, and as the Staff DS you own the most consequential end of it.

Logistics or delivery network experience is a plus, but what matters more is the ability to learn a complex operational domain quickly and model it well.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success.

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.

  • 25 days of holidays.

  • Enhanced parental leave.

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

  • Hardware of your choice.

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role:

Worker Operations is the team that owns end-to-end operations and support for the supply-side (the workers) of our marketplace. We are over 200 team members who serve the 400,000+ (and growing) active professionals on our marketplace. As a Worker Operations Team Lead your primary role is to be an exceptional coach for your team.

Your responsibility is to provide agents with constructive feedback, identify the root causes of performance issues, and train them to address and correct those problems. You maintain high standards for your team and aren’t afraid to say, “This needs improvement, and here’s why.” You ensure that the customer experience remains the focal point of every discussion, set SMART goals for performance improvement, and deliver feedback that aligns with our standards. You’re also hands-on, willing to dive into customer issues directly, and you become a product expert so that you can coach your agents effectively.

  • Maintaining coaching logs and providing regular written feedback to agents

  • Delegate tasks to high potential team members to build a culture of learning and development in the team

  • Suggest and lead team building activities for team motivation

Experience

  • 2+ years of people management experience – Experience leading customer support teams, driving performance, engagement, and accountability.

  • 2+ years of customer support experience – Strong foundation in delivering exceptional customer service and resolving complex customer issues.

  • Customer obsessed – Puts workers at the centre of every decision and consistently delivers a world-class experience.

  • Data-driven problem solver – Uses data, trends, and root cause analysis to identify issues and deliver sustainable improvements.

  • Thrives in ambiguity – Adapts quickly to changing priorities, products, and processes while maintaining high performance.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

Overview

The Operations Strategy Associate role is a generalist role at Clipboard suited for the “all-around athlete” type who can do it all and wants exposure to a range of problems and opportunities.

You’re likely someone who’s interested in and capable of solving different problem types, you’re resourceful, adaptable, and confident you can figure it out if you can sink your teeth in deep enough. These are the ingredients for a problem-solver who is eager to flex into multiple different types of roles and responsibilities depending on what’s needed and most impactful.

While we know that you'll likely start working within one of our Operations teams, we don’t know exactly what work or projects you’ll drive out of the gate, so you’ll notice the work we’re advertising isn’t entirely specific. Some candidates may begin in more execution-focused roles within Operations, depending on their strengths, while others may take on project or team leadership earlier on.

But we’ll make a few promises about the role: it will be high-impact, fast-paced work that directly affects our customers, product, and business.

 

What You May Do

Because you'll be joining the business where your strengths and our highest priorities intersect, no two Associates have exactly the same experience. Here are a few examples of the types of work you may own:

  • Redesign our process for reaching out to workplaces about converting them to new methods of payment, such as getting customers who send checks to start paying us via eCheck to speed up the cash conversion process.

  • Research, vet, and onboard a new vendor that embeds AI agents into our customer-facing efforts.

  • Build an internal predictive analytics model to catch bad payers earlier with high accuracy.

  • Spearhead a quality task force that ensures top quality for our biggest customers.

  • Manage a team of agents within one of our Operations teams.

  • Work directly within workflows, including handling customer interactions, resolving issues, and identifying opportunities to improve the front line processes.

 

Who we're looking for

We find those who are most successful in this type of role:

  • Are insatiably curious and notice non-obvious clues and patterns: Curiosity sits atop our company values. Understanding something from first principles and getting to the root cause of the problem will often reveal the best solution, and a natural and unwavering curiosity to keep asking questions and digging will take you most of the way.

  • Roll up their sleeves and go to the source: There are multiple ways to say this: touching reality, dogfooding, seeing for yourself, going to the front-lines, etc. Don’t just take someone’s word for it – go find out yourself by testing the feature, or listening to the agent call, or calling the customer, or executing the workflow. This is how you seek truth.

  • Bring a tenacity and persistence to problem-solving: You’ll hit walls and find yourself in uncertain and unfamiliar situations. If you can sit with the uncertainty, look at the problem from new angles, and keep applying pressure to a problem – you’ll position yourself for breakthroughs.

  • Bounce back from failure quickly: You’ll make mistakes, move in the wrong direction, and stumble from time-to-time. Just avoid big mistakes and don’t make the same mistakes twice, and learn from them quickly. Worry less about failing and more about losing momentum in your feedback loop. If you fail cheaply and quickly, that's worth the lesson/learning you get in return.

     

We are hiring multiple people and will continue hiring indefinitely for this role. We won’t close the funnel prematurely based on other candidates, but may periodically pause applications due to volume. We will hire everyone who meets our threshold of excellence and hope you meet our criteria.

 

We do not require any experience for this role. Experience will be taken into consideration for both (a) the work you’re placed into once hired and (b) compensation. In addition to experience, these two items are determined by performance during the interview process.

 

Why Join Clipboard?

  • We are remote-first, giving you the flexibility to work with us from many places.

  • Fast-Paced startup environment. Join a company that values curiosity, independence, and growth.

  • A hiring process that rewards skills, not just experience. Every applicant gets a fair shot, our selection is based on real-world problem-solving ability, not just credentials.

  • Opportunity to make a significant impact with our customers on both sides of the marketplace.

 

Hiring Process

  1. Application

  2. Case Study

  3. Case Interview(s) our Operations Leaders

  4. Interview with our Head of Operations

  5. Interview with one of our Co-CEOs

 

*After submitting your application, please check your spam folder periodically over the next few days for updates.

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

Compensation: $50K – $80K

description_html:
Diese Position ist für unsere Gesellschaft Medialine EuroTrade AG zu besetzen.

Du möchtest mehr als nur Tickets weiterleiten und Passwörter zurücksetzen?

Bei uns bearbeitest Du nicht nur Tickets. Du analysierst technische Störungen und Anwenderprobleme, arbeitest mit modernen Technologien und unterstützt Kunden in unterschiedlichen IT-Umgebungen. Dadurch sammelst Du deutlich breitere technische Erfahrung als in vielen klassischen Inhouse-IT-Abteilungen.

Als Teil unseres Service Desks bist Du erster Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Support Engineers zusammen. Wir unterstützen Deine fachliche Weiterentwicklung durch Einarbeitung, Wissenstransfer und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

Aufgaben

  • Annahme und Bearbeitung von Supportanfragen per Telefon, E-Mail und Ticketsystem
  • Unterstützung unserer Kunden bei technischen Problemen und Fragen
  • Analyse und Dokumentation von Störungen
  • Lösung von Standardproblemen im Microsoft-Umfeld
  • Unterstützung bei der Administration von Microsoft- und Cloud-Umgebungen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit unseren System Engineers bei komplexeren Themen
  • arbeiten nach definierten Prozessen und Qualitätsstandards

Qualifikation

Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
  • erste Berufserfahrung im IT-Support oder Service Desk
  • gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Windows Client-Betriebssystemen
  • grundlegende Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365, Active Directory oder Netzwerken
  • Freude an der Analyse technischer Probleme
  • Service- und kundenorientiertes Denken
  • selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung im Systemhaus- oder MSP-Umfeld
  • erste Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, Intune)
  • Grundkenntnisse in Windows-Server-Umgebungen
  • erste Berührungspunkte mit Virtualisierung (Hyper-V oder VMware)
  • ITIL-Kenntnisse oder entsprechende Zertifizierungen

Benefits

Das erwartet Dich

  • ein abwechslungsreiches Arbeitsumfeld mit unterschiedlichen Kunden und Technologien
  • moderne Microsoft- und Cloud-Technologien
  • strukturierte Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen
  • individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Zertifizierungsmöglichkeiten
  • Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung System Engineering oder Spezialisierung

  • Job-Ticket
  • Notebook und Smartphone
  • Workation

description_html:
Mit Freude an der Arbeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein bei allem, was wir tun – so arbeiten wir. Als TOP‑Arbeitgeber schafft unsere Bank dafür die besten Rahmenbedingungen. Rund 650 engagierte Mitarbeitende und eine Bilanzsumme von etwa 5,2 Milliarden Euro machen uns zu einer der großen Regionalbanken im Westmünsterland: Hier sind wir verwurzelt, hier setzen wir uns ein – für eine starke Wirtschaft, eine nachhaltige Lebensqualität und ein persönlich-digitales Banking. Wir begleiten Mitglieder und Kunden auch Durch anspruchsvollste Themen. Unser Geschäftsgebiet erstreckt sich über das westliche und südliche Münsterland bis an die Grenze des Ruhrgebiets.

Aufgaben

Das können Sie bei uns gestalten:

  • Sie übernehmen eigenverantwortlich die Sichtung und fachliche Bewertung aufsichtsrechtlicher Anforderungen und Änderungen im Wertpapier- und Passivgeschäft.
  • Sie wirken an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten und Arbeitsgruppen mit.
  • Sie tragen zu einer kontinuierlichen Prozessverbesserung bei und stellen in Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen eine erforderliche Dokumentation der Aufbau- und Ablauforganisation sicher.
  • Sie unterstützen die Marktfolge Passiv/Wertpapiere sowie die Vertriebseinheiten bei der Umsetzung von Veränderungen im operativen Geschäft. Dabei zählen die Entwicklung von Maßnahmen zur Steigerung der Prozess- als auch Datenqualität zu Ihren Kernaufgaben.
  • Ferner wirken Sie bei der Entwicklung von Maßnahmenplänen zur Behebung identifizierter Schwachstellen mit.
  • Sie stehen als Ansprechpartner für Spezialthemen, Prüfaufträge oder Machbarkeitsstudien zur Verfügung.

Qualifikation

Das macht Sie aus:

  • Sie verfügen über eine fundierte Bankausbildung oder vergleichbare Ausbildung mit betriebswirtschaftlicher Zusatzqualifikation oder ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium.
  • Sie verfügen im Idealfall über langjährige Berufserfahrung im Wertpapier- und Passivgeschäft einer Bank idealerweise gepaart mit Kenntnissen zu aufsichtsrechtlichen Anforderungen.
  • Sie überzeugen durch analytisches Denken, sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikationsstärke.
  • Sie bringen ein hohes Maß an Engagement und Leistungsbereitschaft mit, wobei Teamgeist und der Wunsch, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, zu Ihrem Selbstverständnis gehören.

Benefits

Was Sie von uns erwarten dürfen:

  • Bei uns erwartet Sie eine Arbeitskultur, in der Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Fairness selbstverständlich sind. Die Unterzeichnungen der Charta der Vielfalt, der Charta des Ehrenamts und der Charta der Pflege unterstreichen dieses Selbstverständnis.
  • Wir leben ein kollegiales, wertschätzendes Miteinander in einem engagierten, professionellen Team.
  • Sie finden flexible, familienfreundliche Arbeitszeit‑ und Arbeitsort-modelle – weil Lebensentwürfe unterschiedlich sind.
  • Wir bieten Ihnen attraktive und bedarfsgerechte Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Sie arbeiten beim TOP Employer 2026; übrigens wurden wir nun schon zum 19. Mal ausgezeichnet.
  • Auf Sie warten interessante Benefits z.B. Bike-Leasing, Deutschlandticket als Jobticket, Essenschecks, PC-Leasing, Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio (EGYM Wellpass) etc.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung

title: Sales & Consulting Manager B2B (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at DIU MarTech Solutions GmbH
description_html:
DIU ist führender IT-Dienstleister mit einer über 25-jährigen Tradition. An unseren zwei Büro-Standorten in Hamburg und Wiesbaden sowie deutschlandweit remote entwickeln und integrieren wir IT-Lösungen auf höchstem Niveau.

Zu unseren langjährigen Kunden zählen unter anderem OTTO, R+V Versicherung, Allianz Trade, Suzuki, Deutsche Telekom oder dpv Deutscher Pressevertrieb.

DIU ist geprägt von einer Kultur der Innovation und des Glaubens an die Kraft von Technologien als zentraler Baustein für den Erfolg von Unternehmen. Gestalte jetzt mit uns die Zukunft der IT getreu unseres Mottos: Unleash your power in IT.

Mehr zu uns bei DIU findest du hier: www.diu.digital/

Aufgaben

WANTED

Wir glauben fest daran, dass gute Beziehungen der Kern für nachhaltige Erfolge sind – besonders im Mittelstand. Für den Aufbau und die operative Weiterentwicklung unserer Kundengewinnung im MarTech-Umfeld suchen wir daher einen Sales & Consulting Manager B2B (m/w/d) – jemanden, der Vertrieb nicht als Zahlenspiel versteht, sondern als Beziehungsarbeit.

Wir schreiben die Position im Raum Hamburg im Hybrid-Modell mit 1-2 Tagen Office je Woche aus. Dein Team ist auf die Standorte Hamburg und Wiesbaden (und Umgebung) verteilt und arbeitet schon länger in dieser Besetzung zusammen, denn wir stellen Teams nach Fachgebiet und Interesse zusammen - nicht nach Wohnort. Um die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie zu stärken ist die Stelle sowohl in Voll- als auch Teilzeit z.B. in einer 4-Tage-Woche ausfüllbar.

DOINGS

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Kundendialog – von der Erstansprache über die technische und fachliche Bedarfsanalyse bis zur Übergabe ins Projektteam
  • Du führst Erst- und Discovery-Gespräche, in denen du gezielt nachfragst, um sowohl die technische Ausgangslage (Systeme, Datenflüsse, bestehende MarTech-Tools) als auch das dahinterliegende Business-Problem unserer Ansprechpartner:innen zu verstehen
  • Du identifizierst relevante Unternehmen aus Handel, Versicherung und weiteren Branchen mit komplexen Content- und Marketing-Prozessen und sprichst Entscheider:innen in Marketing, IT und Digital gezielt an
  • Du baust und pflegst ein Netzwerk aus Empfehlungen, Partnern und bestehenden Kundenbeziehungen und ergänzt es durch gezielte Direktansprache
  • Du setzt KI-gestützte Automatisierung für Zielgruppenanalyse, Lead-Qualifizierung und CRM-Pflege ein, statt Vertrieb rein manuell zu betreiben
  • Du koordinierst Termine mit Geschäftsführung und Consultants, bereitest Kundengespräche inhaltlich vor und behältst Follow-ups im Blick
  • Du entwickelst Vertriebs- und Beratungsmaterialien mit – von der Positionierung bis zur kundenspezifischen Präsentation
  • Du spielst Kundenfeedback aus Erstgesprächen direkt ins Consulting- und Projektteam, damit unsere Lösungsvorschläge von Anfang an treffsicher sind

Qualifikation

KNOWHOW

  • 2–5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, Consulting, Partner Management oder Business Development, idealerweise im MarTech-, Software- oder IT-Umfeld
  • Technisches Grundverständnis für digitale Marketing- und Content-Prozesse (Marketing Automation, Content-Management, Schnittstellen/APIs) und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen authentisch und klar zu vermitteln
  • Du hörst genau hin und kannst aus einem Gespräch sowohl das technische Problem als auch das dahinterliegende Business-Anliegen herausarbeiten – dir reicht "wir brauchen ein neues Tool" nicht als Antwort
  • Freude an ehrlicher Kommunikation, vertrauensvoller Zusammenarbeit und persönlichem Beziehungsaufbau statt reinem "Abschluss-Denken"
  • Hohe Selbstorganisation, Strukturdenken und Umsetzungskompetenz – gute Vorbereitung und verlässliche Follow-ups sind für dich selbstverständlich
  • Intrinsische Motivation und echtes Interesse, gemeinsam mit dem Team nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen und hohe Zufriedenheit zu erzielen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

DIU FOR YOU

Bei DIU besetzen wir nicht Stellen, sondern suchen nach Menschen mit Leidenschaft für ihr Fachgebiet. Wir verstehen uns als Plattform für ein Team aus Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft mit anderen teilen oder in Projekte einbringen möchten. Den Rahmen für diese Arbeit schaffen wir mit:

  • Deinem eigenen Weiterbildungs-Budget
  • Zertifizierungen und Weiterbildungen Deiner Wahl
  • Einer agilen Unternehmensorganisation
  • Einer offenen Fehler- und Gesprächskultur
  • Einbeziehung tiefer fachlicher Themen in Management-Entscheidungen

DIU SPIRIT

Wir sind nicht laut - sondern lieber unaufgeregt und verlässlich. Wir entwickeln DIU bewusst strukturiert weiter. Bei uns findest du:

  • Sehr durchmischte Altersstrukturen
  • Eine gute und geregelte Gehaltsstruktur
  • Fachabteilungen für unsere Kerntechnologien / Gleichgesinnte
  • Moderne technische Infrastruktur und Tools
  • Teilzeitmodelle unterschiedlicher Art

GET IN

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, selbst wenn dein Profil nicht exakt auf die Beschreibung passt. Bewirb dich jetzt einfach und unkompliziert über das Bewerbungsformular und unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins sowie deiner Gehaltsvorstellungen.

title: Retail Managerial Opportunities at Oysho
description_html:
About the job

 

Managerial Opportunities at OYSHO- London Area

About us:

Inditex is one of the largest fashion distribution groups in the world, with seven commercial brands: Zara, Pull&Bear, Massimo Dutti, Bershka, Stradivarius, Oysho and Zara Home. We are what you wear to work, what you decide to decorate your life with, what you choose for that special occasion.

We love what we do. Teamwork, passion, curiosity, diversity, sustainability, creativity and humility are the daily motivation for the more than 174,000 individuals who make up the Inditex group.

How we imagine you:

We are seeking passionate people that are looking for a challenging yet rewarding career in fashion. The ideal candidate will have a track record of commerciality ,people management and understanding of customer service .You will work in a fast –paced environment and you will be able to multi task between your key responsibilities

What we expect from you:

Our Managers ensure that the business is run efficiently by encouraging the team and controlling the product and commerciality of the store. Some of your responsibilities will be to:

  • Monitor and analyse commercial and product data to improve the sales and productivity of your store

  • Oversee the store’s operational tasks

  • Motivate and develop your team

  • Be an ambassador for our companies sustainability project

What we offer:

In addition to a competitive salary, you will also receive 25% discount to buy the latest trends in any of our brands, company pension scheme, holiday allowance of 28 days and a ‘More For Less’  benefit package where you can find a wide range of discounts.

Our internal talent is our greatest asset and we are proud of offering internal promotion programmes where you will find opportunities to grow, e-learning and training programmes - we never stop learning! Social projects to get involved in and contribute to a better society and much more!

We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment processes are barrier free and as inclusive as possible to everyone .This includes making adjustments for people with disabilities or long term conditions.

title: Product Designer - Mobile
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Kpler
description_html:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Product Designer at Kpler, you will play a key role in shaping how global decision-makers interact with complex energy, maritime, and commodity trade intelligence. Working within a collaborative cross-functional product squad, you will craft intuitive end-to-end user journeys, turn intricate data workflows into elegant interfaces, and champion design quality across our web and terminal platforms. Leveraging Figma and our design system, your work will directly empower thousands of analysts and traders around the world to extract instant, actionable insights.


Key Responsibilities

 

  • Design intuitive product experiences: Conceptualize, prototype, and deliver user-centered design solutions in Figma for new product capabilities and core workflow enhancements.

  • Translate complex data into clear interfaces: Distill intricate data flows, geospatial mapping tools, and market analytics into simple, human-centric user interfaces.

  • Evolve and leverage our design system: Adhere to and contribute to Kpler’s shared design system (Atlas) to maintain visual consistency, component quality, and usability standards.

  • Craft 3–6 month product design visions: Partner with Product Managers and Engineering leads to define user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes for upcoming product milestones.

  • Validate designs through research and feedback: Gather user feedback, analyze interaction patterns, and iterate rapidly to refine interaction details, micro-copy, and edge-case behaviors.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work seamlessly with engineers and product stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure design intent and quality are preserved in production.


Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • Product design experience: 2–4 years of professional experience as a Product Designer crafting web applications, complex dashboards, or data-intensive B2B software products.

  • Figma proficiency: Advanced mastery of Figma, including auto-layout, interactive components, design tokens, responsive layout rules, and prototyping best practices.

  • End-to-end UX/UI craft: Demonstrated ability to drive design projects from discovery and user flow mapping through to pixel-perfect visual design and developer handoff.

  • Problem-solving mindset: Strong knack for simplifying dense, multi-step workflows into clear, frictionless user journeys.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English to articulate design rationale and align with product and engineering peers.

    • Nice-to-haves

    • Data-dense or B2B platforms: Experience designing interfaces for SaaS, analytics, financial terminals, supply chain, or maritime tools.

    • Design system contributions: Prior experience maintaining or scaling a shared component library in a multi-team environment.

    • Usability testing & research: Practical experience conducting qualitative user interviews or usability testing sessions.

title: Senior Product Manager - User Platform
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Spotify
description_html:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

User Platform builds the identity and access capabilities that help people use Spotify safely and easily. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape how people access Spotify and stay connected across our apps, devices, and strategic partner integrations. You’ll focus on session management - how Spotify recognizes someone after they sign in, maintains their access, and enables them to connect or disconnect devices and applications.

You’ll bring together consumer experience and technical product strategy, working closely with engineering, design, research, insights, security, and teams responsible for Spotify’s clients and partnerships. Your decisions will help people get to the experiences they want, stay in control of their access, and use Spotify with confidence.

What You'll Do
  • Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for session management across Spotify’s clients, device types, and strategic partner integrations.
  • Use research, data, and feedback from users and developers to identify access friction and prioritize improvements with the greatest potential impact.
  • Improve how sessions are established, maintained, and ended, balancing reliable access with account protection, privacy, and user control.
  • Shape device connection, session transfer, and partner authorization experiences, including clear consent when an app requests access or additional capabilities.
  • Partner with engineering to make session and access capabilities reusable and easier to adopt through APIs, client components, documentation, and clear integration guidance.
  • Work across client, device, and partner teams to understand different needs, align priorities, and carry improvements through delivery and adoption.
  • Define success measures for access quality, user friction, developer experience, and adoption, connecting those measures to meaningful user and business outcomes.
  • Make thoughtful trade-offs between immediate experience improvements, long-term technical investment, security, and privacy while providing teams with clear direction and context.

    • Who You Are
  • You have several years of product management experience and can demonstrate how products you’ve shipped improved outcomes for users or developers.
  • You have experience working on consumer products, identity and access, connected devices, developer products, or partner integrations.
  • You understand how technical capabilities such as session management, authorization, APIs, client behavior, or consent flows can shape the end-user and developer experience.
  • You have strong product and user experience judgment and enjoy working with design, research, and engineering to make complicated interactions easier to understand and use.
  • You can reason through technical trade-offs with engineers and translate complex product and technical decisions into clear language for different audiences.
  • You use research and data to test assumptions, measure impact, and make sound decisions when evidence is incomplete.
  • You have led work across teams with different priorities and can build productive relationships with technical and business partners.
  • You can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear strategy, make difficult prioritization decisions, follow through on delivery, and contribute to an inclusive and collaborative product community.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London or Stockholm
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
    • Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

    At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

    Spotify transformed music listening forever when we launched in 2008. Our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. Everything we do is driven by our love for music and podcasting. Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Onboarding Manager SaaS (m/w/d) in München / Berlin
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Convercus
description_html:
Über Convercus

Convercus ist eine führende Loyalty- und Couponing-Software Plattform für Enterprise- und Mid-Market-Unternehmen in Europa. Mit unserer Technologie helfen wir Marken dabei, Kundenbeziehungen nachhaltig aufzubauen, Kundenbindung messbar zu steigern und hochperformante Loyalty-Programme zu entwickeln.

Als wachsendes Scale-up verbinden wir die Dynamik eines Start-ups mit der Professionalität eines Enterprise-Software-Anbieters. Wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Chancen erkennen und ihren Bereich aktiv gestalten wollen – nicht auf Anweisungen warten.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Als Onboarding Manager bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson unserer Kunden während der Einführung unserer Loyalty-Plattform.

Du begleitest Kunden von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live und sorgst dafür, dass aus Anforderungen erfolgreiche, skalierbare und produktnahe Lösungen entstehen.

Dabei geht es um weit mehr als klassisches Projektmanagement: Du verstehst Geschäftsprozesse, analysierst technische Zusammenhänge und entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für unsere Plattform. Du führst Kunden aktiv zu Best Practices, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und schaffst die Grundlage für langfristigen Kundenerfolg.

Gleichzeitig gestaltest du unser Onboarding aktiv weiter: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Muster, verbesserst Prozesse, schaffst Standards und nutzt Automatisierung, um Projekte effizienter, klarer und skalierbarer zu machen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für den Projekterfolg und arbeitest eng mit Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, Sales und externen Stakeholdern zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

Kunden-Onboarding verantworten

  • Eigenverantwortliche Planung, Steuerung und erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Kunden-Onboarding-Projekten im SaaS-Umfeld – von Kickoff bis Go-Live.
  • Führung des Kunden durch alle Projektphasen: Zeitplanung, fachliche Konzeption, technische Klärung, Umsetzung, Test, Enablement und Einführung.
  • Erstellung und Pflege von Projektplänen, Meilensteinen, Statusreports, Risikoanalysen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen.
  • Proaktives Monitoring von Projektfortschritt, Qualität, Budget und Abhängigkeiten.

Anforderungen verstehen und in Plattformlösungen übersetzen

  • Analyse von Kundenprozessen und Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in skalierbare Plattformlösungen.
  • Beratung von Fach- und IT-Abteilungen in den Bereichen Loyalty, CRM, Marketing Automation, E-Commerce, POS, ERP und Datenintegration.
  • Strukturierung von Anforderungen, offenen Punkten, Risiken und Entscheidungen für Kunden und interne Teams.
  • Unterstützung bei der Klärung technischer Integrationen, Datenflüsse und Systemarchitekturen.

Kunden aktiv führen

  • Aktive Führung des Kunden hin zu produktkonformen Best Practices.
  • Konstruktives Hinterfragen, Umlenken oder Ablehnen von Anforderungen, die nicht zur Produktstrategie oder Standardplattform passen.
  • Souveräne Kommunikation mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern – von Fachabteilungen bis zu technischen Teams und Management.
  • Sicherstellung, dass Kundenentscheidungen nachvollziehbar, dokumentiert und umsetzbar sind.

Cross-funktional zusammenarbeiten

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management, Engineering, Data, Sales und Customer Success.
  • Einbringen von Kundenfeedback, Projekterkenntnissen und Best Practices in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform und Prozesse.
  • Sicherstellung reibungsloser Übergaben aus dem Sales-Prozess in die Implementierung und vom Go-Live in den laufenden Betrieb.
  • Aktive und eigenständige Weiterentwicklung deines Produktwissens und kontinuierliche Einarbeitung in neue Features, Plattformlogiken und Integrationsmuster.

Qualifikation

Das brings du mit

  • 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, Onboarding oder in der Implementierung von SaaS-, Software- oder Plattformlösungen.
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Fach- und IT-Abteilungen in B2B- oder Enterprise-Umfeldern.
  • Verständnis für Systemlandschaften rund um CRM, Marketing Automation, E-Commerce, POS, ERP, DWH, BI oder Datenintegration.
  • Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen zu analysieren und in technische oder produktnahe Lösungsansätze zu übersetzen.

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Business-Verständnis

Du verstehst nicht nur Projekt Management, sondern auch Software, Geschäftsmodelle, Loyalty Prozesse und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge.

Exzellente Kommunikation

Du kannst komplexe technische Themen verständlich erklären – sowohl gegenüber Fachabteilungen als auch gegenüber technischen Experten.

Ownership

Du übernimmst Verantwortung, denkst unternehmerisch und bringst Themen aktiv und eigenständig voran.

Kundenorientierung

Du begeisterst Kunden durch Fachwissen, Professionalität und den echten Willen, Probleme zu lösen.

Zusammenarbeit

Du arbeitest gerne bereichsübergreifend und verstehst dich als Brücke zwischen Vertrieb, Onboarding, Product und Customer Success.

Orientierung in offenen Situationen
Du findest auch in offenen Situationen eigenständig einen klaren Weg nach vorne.

Benefits

Warum Convercus?

Echten Impact schaffen

Wir glauben, dass großartige Ergebnisse entstehen, wenn Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen. Bei Convercus bekommst du den Freiraum, deinen Bereich aktiv zu gestalten, Entscheidungen zu treffen und sichtbaren Einfluss auf den Unternehmenserfolg zu haben.

Wachstum mitgestalten

Du wirst Teil eines Scale-ups, das sich in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase befindet. Deine Ideen, Erfahrungen und Initiativen machen einen echten Unterschied.

Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe

Wir arbeiten eng über Teamgrenzen hinweg zusammen. Sales, Customer Success und Product ziehen gemeinsam an einem Strang, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen.

Moderne Technologie

Du arbeitest mit modernen SaaS- und AI-Tools und verkaufst eine Lösung, die bei führenden Unternehmen einen direkten messbaren Business Impact erzeugt.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf zu erfahren, wie du gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft von Loyalty, Customer Engagement und Enterprise Commerce gestalten wirst.

title: Senior Controller (m/w/d) in Berlin – Finance & Controlling bei momox SE
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at momox
description_html:
Unsere Mission

Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, unseren Planeten zu retten – ein Second Hand Produkt nach dem anderen.

Das Controlling bei momox ist ein Team von vier Personen für ein Unternehmen mit 400 Mio. € Umsatz. Das funktioniert nur, weil bei uns niemand Zahlen verwaltet, sondern jeder sein Thema von der Query bis zur Empfehlung ans Senior Management verantwortet und weil wir konsequent automatisieren, was sich automatisieren lässt. KI ist dabei kein Pilotprojekt, sondern täglicher Bestandteil der Arbeit. Wir suchen jemanden mit dem fachlichen Standing, eigene Themen gegenüber Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen zu vertreten und mit dem Anspruch, Controlling technisch weiterzudenken.

Das wirst du meistern

  • Management Reporting & Steuerung: Du verantwortest das monatliche Reporting fürs Senior Management inkl. Abweichungsanalysen über Geschäftsbereiche, Vertriebskanäle und Ankaufsländer, und du kommentierst so, dass eine Entscheidung daraus folgt
  • Planung & Forecasting: Du treibst Budget und Quartals-Forecasts, moderierst die Planungsrunden mit Geschäftsführung und Bereichsleitungen und verantwortest das Planungsmodell
  • Deckungsbeitragssteuerung: Du entwickelst unsere Deckungsbeitragsrechnung fachlich weiter und stellst den relevanten Fachbereichen die Kostenbasis für kostendeckende Entscheidungen im An- und Verkauf bereit
  • Business Partnering: Ad-hoc-Analysen, Sonderauswertungen, Profitabilitätshebel - du findest sie selbst, bewertest sie und bringst sie in den Fachbereichen zum Fliegen
  • Daten, Automatisierung & KI: Du ziehst dir deine Daten selbst per SQL aus BigQuery, baust Reports in Looker und automatisierst wiederkehrende Auswertungen, statt sie jeden Monat neu zu klicken. KI-Tools nutzt du dabei für echte Controlling-Arbeit: Datenaufbereitung, Analyse, Code, Prüfroutinen, und entwickelst unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mit weiter

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Controlling eines datengetriebenen Unternehmens (E-Commerce, Handel, Logistik o. ä.)
  • SQL auf Analystenniveau - du wartest nicht auf BI, du schreibst die Query
  • Souverän in Excel/Power Query und in der Modellierung komplexer Planungsrechnungen
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von GuV, Deckungsbeitragsrechnung und Monatsabschluss
  • Praxis im Einsatz von KI-Tools in der eigenen Arbeit - du kannst konkret beschreiben, welchen Prozess du damit verkürzt oder abgeschafft hast
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Zahlen verständlich und auf den Punkt zu vermitteln
  • Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir arbeiten nach einem hybriden Modell mit 20 Office-Tagen pro Quartal, die den persönlichen Austausch im Team fördern und gleichzeitig eine moderne, flexible Arbeitsweise ermöglichen. An den übrigen Tagen kannst du von zuhause aus arbeiten - zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr aus Ländern innerhalb der EU zu arbeiten. Außerdem profitierst du von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die sich an deine individuellen Bedürfnisse anpassen.
  • Individuelle Arbeitsumgebung: Gestalte deinen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz ganz nach deinen Wünschen – mit höhenverstellbaren Tischen und dem Laptop deiner Wahl (MacBook oder ThinkPad). Wenn es im Büro mal etwas lauter wird, sorgen deine Bose Noise-Cancelling-Kopfhörer für ungestörtes Arbeiten. Bei Bedarf stellen wir dir auch einen ergonomischen Stuhl oder zusätzliche Monitore für dein Homeoffice zur Verfügung.
  • Offenes Arbeitsumfeld: Wir arbeiten gemeinsam in einem hellen, offenen Großraumbüro, in dem die wenigen vorhandenen Türen immer offen stehen. Unsere Teams sind motiviert und aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen. Bringe deine Kreativität ein und setze sie um! Wenn du einen Moment der Ruhe brauchst, kannst du dich in eine gemütliche Ecke der medimops-Bibliothek im Pausenraum zurückziehen oder dich bei einer Runde Kicker, Tischtennis oder an der PlayStation austoben.
  • Sport- und Fitnessangebote: Unter der Woche hast du die Möglichkeit, an verschiedenen Sportangeboten teilzunehmen. Ob Online-Training, Massagen oder Stretching am Arbeitsplatz – es ist für jeden etwas dabei. Außerdem kannst du zu einem vergünstigten Mitgliedspreis ein Abo bei Urban Sports Club oder Wellhub abschließen.
  • Reduziertes Ticket für den Nahverkehr: Spare bares Geld mit dem Deutschland- oder Jobticket der Berliner S-Bahn.
  • Firmenfeiern: Der Spaß an unserer Arbeit und das gemeinsame Feiern unserer Erfolge sind fest in unseren Werten verankert. Deshalb treffen wir uns regelmäßig zu verschiedenen Events, um uns auszutauschen, besser kennenzulernen und unseren Teamgeist weiter zu stärken.
  • 1/2 Tag Urlaub am Geburtstag: An deinem Geburtstag bekommst du einen halben Tag Urlaub. Komm später, geh früher oder nimm einfach noch einen halben Tag Urlaub dazu, um deinen ganzen Geburtstag frei zu haben – vorausgesetzt, dein Geburtstag fällt auf einen regulären Arbeitstag. Außerdem bekommst du am 24.12. und 31.12. je einen halben Tag frei.
  • Unternehmensrabatte: Als momoxian kannst du dich jeden Monat auf einen Gutschein für unseren momox Fashion Onlineshop, sowie medimops freuen. Darüber hinaus profitierst du natürlich von zahlreichen Unternehmensrabatten unserer Partner.
  • Weiterbildung: momox ist nur so gut wie du. Deshalb findest du bei uns Raum und Budget für deine individuelle professionelle Entwicklung mit Sprachkursen, internen Schulungen, Konferenzen, (Online-) Kursen und mehr.
  • Bürohunde: Unsere Bürohunde tragen zu einer entspannten Arbeitsatmosphäre bei und freuen sich immer über eine extra Portion Streicheleinheiten.

title: Head of Data Engineering
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at PHMG Careers
description_html:
Role: Head of Data Engineering

Location: Manchester based office – Hybrid working

Package: £98k OTE

 

PHMG is continuing to develop and mature its data capability, focusing on modernising our data platform and enhancing the way we work. This creates further opportunities to leverage data more effectively, allowing us to better serve our customers and colleagues. As part of this continued development, we are looking to strengthen our Data Engineering capability and maximise the value from the wealth of data held across the organisation. 

To support this vision, we are seeking a Head of Data Engineering. This pivotal role will lead an established Data Engineering team, supporting their development while strengthening engineering practices, technical standards and ways of working across the function. The successful candidate will foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement. 

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced data engineering leader to help develop our data engineering community of practice, define data standards across the organisation and be part of the team delivering and evolving PHMG's Data Strategy. 

The role: What you will do: 

  • Lead, manage and develop the Data Engineering team, building capability, resilience and strong ways of working.
  • Own PHMG's core data platform, architecture, data warehouse and associated pipelines, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable and cost-effective.
  • Own Data Engineering delivery, ensuring work is appropriately designed, prioritised and delivered to agreed standards.
  • Establish and embed strong engineering practices across source control, CI/CD, testing, code review, documentation, monitoring and error handling.
  • Work closely with the wider Data team to translate the Data Strategy and business priorities into an effective engineering roadmap and delivery plan.
  • Work closely with IT, Infrastructure and other engineering teams on architecture, integrations, migrations and platform decisions.
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities to improve the performance, reliability and efficiency of PHMG's data capability, including the use of emerging technologies.

This is an exciting role for an experienced data engineering leader who has: 

  • Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing Data Engineering teams.
  • A strong track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, solutions and architectures.
  • A thorough understanding of modern ETL/ELT practices and experience designing scalable, reliable and maintainable data pipelines.
  • Advanced working knowledge of SQL and Python.
  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift or BigQuery. Experience within the Microsoft data ecosystem would be advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of modern engineering practices including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, code review, monitoring and observability.
  • Strong experience of data modelling for reporting and analytics, using tools and approaches such as dbt or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, governance, security and data management best practices.
  • Experience managing engineering delivery using agile ways of working.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to have experience: 

  • Experience integrating data with operational systems, including reverse ETL into platforms such as Salesforce.
  • Understanding of the Data Science / Machine Learning lifecycle and MLOps.
  • Experience using Infrastructure as Code approaches and tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

Why PHMG Tech:  

The IT, Development and Data functions within PHMG continue to evolve how we use technology and data to deliver value to the business. We want to build an open, collaborative culture where people communicate honestly, support each other and take pride in delivering good work. 

About PHMG: 

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a renowned Manchester-based business to the world's leading audio branding agency – working with 36,000 clients in 54 countries across the globe. This expansive client list includes household names of the calibre of Samsung, Audi and Adidas, as well as SMEs in every sector of the global market. We give each of them a stellar production that combines creative copy, world-class voice artistry and an exclusive Brand-Sound-Track™ – strengthening their business identity in the most memorable, emotive way.
