title: Team Lead Sales Development
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at trawa
description_html:
Team Lead Sales Development

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Deine Mission

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen.

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.

Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen.

Wir suchen eine:n Team Lead Sales Development (SDR), um gemeinsam die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu erreichen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Sales und arbeitest eng mit unseren Commercial-Teams zusammen. Du gestaltest das Produkt mit, das die europäische Industrie wieder wettbewerbsfähiger macht – und setzt deine Ideen mit hohem Tempo um.

Die Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. trawa ist ein Office-First-Unternehmen: In der Regel arbeitest du an fünf Tagen pro Woche aus unserem Büro.

Das Team

Das trawa SDR-Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber des Unternehmens und einer unserer wichtigsten Kanäle zur Generierung neuer Kundenbeziehungen. Das derzeit sechsköpfige Team vereint vielseitige Erfahrungen im Vertrieb und schafft dadurch ein dynamisches Umfeld. Nach einer Phase starken Wachstums liegt der Fokus nun darauf, diesen Erfolg weiter auszubauen und gemeinsam den nächsten Wachstumsschritt zu gestalten.

Wen wir suchen

  • Als Player-Coach übernimmst du die Verantwortung für den Erfolg des SDR-Teams und bist gleichzeitig selbst operativ aktiv. Du verbringst den überwiegenden Teil deiner Zeit mit Cold Calling und gehst mit deiner eigenen Performance als gutes Beispiel voran.

  • Du verantwortest die Team-Performance ganzheitlich, steuerst die Zielerreichung und entwickelst das Team kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in Prozessen und Strukturen, bringst die Perspektive des Teams aktiv ein und setzt gemeinsam mit den relevanten Stakeholdern im Unternehmen Verbesserungen um.

  • Du bist ein zentraler Bestandteil des Recruiting-Prozesses für neue SDRs und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team für ein strukturiertes und erfolgreiches Onboarding neuer Teammitglieder.

Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du hast ein fundiertes Verständnis für unsere Produkte und den Energiemarkt aufgebaut.

  • Du hast dich als feste Ansprechperson für alle Themen rund um das SDR-Team etabliert.

  • Deine eigene Performance im Cold Calling setzt erste neue Maßstäbe.

  • Du hast erste Optimierungspotenziale zur Steigerung der Team-Performance identifiziert und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen abgeleitet.

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Überzeugungskraft und hohes Durchsetzungsvermögen zeichnen dich aus.

  • Du kommst leicht mit Menschen ins Gespräch, verstehst Bedürfnisse und stellst passende Lösungen überzeugend vor.

  • Du gehst Aufgaben mit Eigeninitiative und klarer Zielorientierung an.

  • Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert: Komplexe Prozesse zerlegst du gerne in einzelne Schritte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und Metriken.

  • Du hast umfangreiche Erfahrungen rund um vertrieblichen Methoden und Techniken.

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Warum trawa?

Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt.

Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung.

description_html:
Operations Intern - Renewable Supply

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Unsere Mission für dich

Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen und werde Teil unseres wachsenden Operations-Teams! trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie auf. Unsere Mission ist es, Industriekunden mit nachhaltigen Energielösungen zu versorgen. Mit einem innovativen Ansatz, der Energieversorgung, fortschrittliche Energiemanagementsoftware und intelligente Optimierung von Energieverbrauchsdiensten kombiniert, helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, erfolgreich zu bleiben und den Weg in eine klimafreundliche Energiezukunft zu ebnen.

Das Team

Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, eingespielten Onboarding-Teams mit vier Personen. Als Teil des Business Operations Departments arbeitest du in einem Bereich mit insgesamt rund 20 Kolleginnen und Kollegen, zu dem auch das Customer Success Team gehört. Im Alltag verbindet uns eine enge, cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit, mit der wir gemeinsam die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden erzielen. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, denken mit und packen gemeinsam an. Gleichzeitig pflegen wir eine Teamkultur, die über den Arbeitsalltag hinausgeht – und eine Company Culture, auf die wir wirklich stolz sind.

Als Operations Intern (m/w/d) spielst du eine Schlüsselrolle im Aufbau von Prozessen und Strukturen eines aufstrebenden und schnell wachsenden Technologie-Startups. Wir stellen fortlaufend für eine Praktikumsdauer von 3–6 Monaten ein.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ownership für operative Prozesse: Du führst entscheidende operative Aufgaben in Eigenverantwortung durch und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Organisation in allen Kernbereichen reibungslos läuft.

  • Automatisierung von Prozessen: Du entwickelst Ansätze zur Effizienzsteigerung und Automatisierung von Prozessschritten.

  • Begleitung beim Onboarding: Du unterstützt bei der Einführung unserer Neukund:innen in das trawa-Universum und sorgst für eine exzellente Kundenerfahrung.

  • Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Organisation: Du gestaltest Prozesse aktiv mit und hilfst uns dabei, als Unternehmen weiter wachsen zu können.

  • Daten im Blick behalten: Du übernimmst die Datenpflege in unseren Systemen (z. B. CRM) und stellst durch sorgfältige Arbeit eine hohe Datenqualität sicher.

Nach wem wir suchen

  • Du bist Student:in, im Bachelor-Studium, Gap Year, Master-Studium oder Absolvent:in mit guten akademischen Leistungen.

  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen in Startups, anderen schnelllebigen Umfeldern oder der Energiewirtschaft sind ein starkes Plus.

  • Du denkst analytisch, fühlst dich wohl im Analysieren von Zahlen und kommunizierst datenbasierte Erkenntnisse sicher.

  • Organisationstalent zeichnet dich aus – du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst den Überblick und kannst Aufgaben effizient priorisieren.

  • Du besitzt eine generelle Affinität für digitale Tools wie z. B. CRM-Systeme, Notion, Google Workspace oder n8n.

Deine ersten 90 Tage:

Die ersten sechs Wochen – Orientierung und Einarbeitung

  • Lerne unsere Prozesse kennen – vom internen Handover der Neukunden von Sales, über die Anmeldung von Lieferstellen bis hin zur Marktkommunikation im komplexen Energiemarkt.

  • Mache dich mit den wichtigsten Tools, Systemen sowie internen und externen Ansprechpartnern vertraut, die beim Onboarding unserer Neukunden eine Rolle spielen.

  • Führe deine ersten Kunden-Onboardings eigenständig durch: Stelle die „Handover-Readiness" durch Sales sicher, richte das Kundenportal ein, initiiere den Kundenkontakt, melde Lieferstellen an und löse Probleme in der Marktkommunikation.

Bis zum dritten Monat – Verantwortung übernehmen und Prozesse weiterentwickeln

  • Übernimm Kunden-Onboardings eigenständig und verantworte Timelines sowie die Kommunikation mit allen Beteiligten.

  • Entwickle ein belastbares Verständnis für Marktkommunikationsprozesse und werde zur verlässlichen Ansprechperson bei Problemen in deinem Bereich.

  • Erkenne wiederkehrende Muster in typischen Fehlern und bring eigene Ideen ein, um unsere Onboarding-Prozesse gezielt zu verbessern.

Warum wir?

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss haben – auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und die Umwelt. Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Dein Impact: Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unserem dynamischen Team und gestaltest aktiv innovative Produkte, die die Energiewende vorantreiben und zur Dekarbonisierung des Mittelstandes beitragen.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: In unserem schönen Office fördern wir eine lebendige Unternehmenskultur. Homeoffice ist ebenfalls eine Option. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Urlaubstagen und 10 Tagen Workation unterstützen wir deine Work-Life-Balance.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, eine Urban Sports-Mitgliedschaft, reichlich kostenlose Snacks und ein persönliches Produktivitätsbudget.

  • Persönliche Entwicklung: Du bist Teil eines tollen Teams, wo Coaching und Mentoring groß geschrieben wird, und arbeitest mit Spitzentechnologien und lernst von Branchenexpert:innen.

  • Vielfalt & Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen – wir engagieren uns für einen integrativen Arbeitsplatz, der Vielfalt wertschätzt. Wir ermutigen Menschen unterschiedlichen Geschlechts, Alters, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sozialer Herkunft und körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung.

Über uns

Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen, entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen, und professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite.

  • Architekt:in effizienter Prozesse: Du verbesserst unsere Prozesse, die unsere Abläufe zukunftssicher, effizient und präzise machen. Da trawa stark wächst und in neue Märkte expandiert, gibt es regelmäßig Gelegenheit, Prozesse von Grund auf neu zu denken.

  • Pragmatische:r Problemlöser:in: Du erkennst Herausforderungen frühzeitig, triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen und verbesserst kontinuierlich Qualität und Effizienz.

  • Energiewirtschaftliches Interesse: Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Einblicke in Themen wie Direktvermarktung, Virtual Power Plants, Metering oder die Steuerung von Batteriespeichern gewonnen und möchtest dich in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln.

Genauso souverän arbeitest du intern unter anderem mit Sales, Product und Tech zusammen und übersetzt zwischen kommerzieller, operativer und technischer Perspektive.

  • Einfallsreichtum und Eigeninitiative: Wenn du eine Antwort nicht kennst, findest du sie – in der Knowledge Base, im Team oder durch einen direkten Anruf mit externen Parteien.

  • Technologieaffinität: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit PowerPoint und Excel, kannst Daten und Visualisierungen souverän auswerten und hast ein Faible für KI-gestützte Tools und Automatisierungsplattformen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und sehr gutes Englisch. Weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

  • Leidenschaft für die Energiewende: Du begeisterst dich für erneuerbare Energien und willst aktiv dazu beitragen.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Du kennst den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess für Batteriespeicher, PV-Anlagen und DERs im Detail, von der Datenerfassung bis zur Anbindung an Handel und Direktvermarktung.

  • Du betreust eigenständig laufende Kundenanbindungen und bist für definierte Prozessschritte die verlässliche Ansprechperson im Team.

  • Du hast belastbare Beziehungen zu allen relevanten internen und externen Stakeholdern aufgebaut und bist im Team fachlich wie persönlich gut integriert.

  • Du hast erste eigene Projekte übernommen und treibst diese selbstständig voran, um konkrete Verbesserungen in unseren Prozessen umzusetzen.

Warum wir?

  • Dein Impact: Du arbeitest an echten Lösungen für eine nachhaltige Zukunft und siehst, was du bewirkst. Dein Beitrag hilft Unternehmen, ihre Emissionen zu senken und ihre Energieversorgung smarter zu gestalten.

  • Office First Kultur: Unser schönes Office in Berlin Mitte ist das Herz unserer Zusammenarbeit. Wir leben eine Kultur, in der wir als Team vor Ort wirken, voneinander lernen und Geschwindigkeit aufnehmen – das ist uns sehr wichtig. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen unserer Office-First-Kultur und 30 Urlaubstagen unterstützen wir dich – ob für Familie, persönliche Projekte oder Erholung.

title: Accounts Receivable Accountant

description_html:
Accounts Receivable Accountant

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

Our Mission For You

Own the process that turns invoices into cash, and shape how trawa's Finance function scales with our customer base.

trawa enables mid-sized industrial and commercial companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're in a hyper-growth phase in one of the most complex markets in Germany. It's a rare moment to join: the foundations are being built right now, the problems are real, and the room to shape how Finance runs at scale is wide open.

This is one of the most critical roles in the company. Cash is what enables trawa's growth, and you own the process that protects it. Every reconciliation you close, every overdue account you resolve, every dispute you clean up feeds directly into how fast we can move.

As our Accounts Receivable Accountant, you'll own the end-to-end AR and collections process. You'll be the person customers talk to when something on an invoice isn't clear, and the person internally who makes sure open items don't stay open. You'll work closely with Customer Success, Business Operations, and our Finance team.

If you're excited by ownership, an AI-first way of working, and building something that actually matters, this is your role.


What You'll Own

Collections and Dunning

  • Own the collections cadence end-to-end: monitor AR aging, prioritise the highest-impact accounts, and drive them to resolution via email and phone.

  • Reduce DSO measurably. You set the pace, we give you the tools and the mandate.

  • Manage our dunning process reliably and with the right tone: firm on cash, respectful of the customer relationshipDebitorenbuchhaltung und operative Prozesse.

Reconciliation and Cash Application

  • Reconcile incoming payments against open invoices, investigate and resolve unapplied cash, short-pays, and discrepancies.

  • Run structured reconciliations reliably, and independently drive ad-hoc analyses for complex payments or edge cases.

  • Support month-end close with AR reconciliations and clean aging reports.

Ticket Ownership and Customer Interaction

  • Take ownership of our AR ticket queue, which is currently high-volume and one of the most visible pain points across the company. You get on top of it, categorise what's coming in, and resolve the majority of tickets directly.

  • Be the go-to Finance contact for customers on all relevant topics: invoicing, payments, and account requests.

  • Work closely with Customer Success and BizOps to resolve customer issues end-to-end and make sure Finance topics don't get stuck between teams.


Who You Are

Must-haves

  • 3+ years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Collections, or Credit Control, or a comparable Finance role. Ideally in a high-volume and complex B2B environment

  • Solid understanding of AR processes: dunning, cash application, reconciliations, and month-end AR work.

  • Confident with customers in writing and on the phone. You can be firm on cash without damaging the relationship.

  • Strong ownership mindset. You don't wait for someone to flag a problem. You spot it, dig into the root cause, and drive it to resolution across stakeholders.

  • Structured, analytical, and detail-oriented. You keep complex open items straight without losing the bigger picture.

  • Business fluent in English and solid written German (customer correspondence in German needs to work reliably). Spoken German is a strong plus but not required.

  • Comfortable in the standard office and analytics toolset (Excel or Google Sheets) and able to navigate independently.

Nice-to-haves

  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a comparable field, or a solid vocational qualification (e.g. Bilanzbuchhalter:in IHK, Steuerfachangestellte:r, kaufmännische Ausbildung). We care about what you can do, not the badge on your CV.

  • Experience with AI-powered reconciliation tools or modern ticketing systems.

  • Genuine curiosity for AI and automation. Bonus if you've already used Langdock, Claude, or similar tools to speed up your own work.

  • Experience in a fast-growing start-up or scale-up environment.


Your First 90 Days

Month 1: Understand

  • Understand trawa's business model, customer base, and billing logic, including what makes energy billing genuinely complex

  • Map our AR process end-to-end (invoicing, collections, cash application, close) and get to know your key counterparts in Customer Success, BizOps, and Accounting

  • Take over recurring work: ticket triage, aging analysis, dunning follow-ups

Month 2: Take Ownership

  • Run the AR cycle largely independently: aging monitored proactively, customer follow-ups sent on time, accounts reconciled cleanly

  • Contribute to your first month-end close reliably and on time

  • Identify one concrete process gap in collections, reconciliation, or ticket handling, and come with a plan to fix it

Month 3: Build and Improve

  • You're the reliable Finance point of contact for customer-facing AR topics. The ticket backlog is under control and issues get resolved before they escalate

  • DSO is trending in the right direction and month-end contributions are delivered without follow-up

  • You've shipped at least one meaningful process improvement and can point to its impact

  • You're actively shaping how our AR processes scale as trawa's customer base grows


Why trawa?

  • Direct collaboration with Finance leadership and cross-functional leaders from day one. Short paths, real decisions, real ownership

  • A uniquely complex business at the intersection of energy, software, and B2B operations. You'll learn a lot, fast

  • An AI-first and automation-first Finance team. You'll set up scalable processes and drive them forward through process automation and larger tool implementations.

  • Real room to grow as trawa scales, your scope grows with the company.

  • Flexible working, 30 vacation days, L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, Urban Sports Club membership, and a vibrant office culture in Berlin

description_html:
🚀 YOUR OPPORTUNITY

Want real hands-on experience in B2B SaaS marketing — running webinars, shaping demand gen campaigns, and building the AI-powered systems that run our marketing team? Then it's an exciting time to join Luminovo!

We help electronics manufacturers and OEMs manage one of the most complex supply chains in the world by bringing sourcing, quoting, and procurement into a single, modern platform. As we scale, our marketing team needs more hands to keep webinars, campaigns, and content moving — and that's where you come in.

Here's what makes this opportunity different: we run "AI by default", and we're one of the first marketing teams making tools like Claude a daily habit, not a nice-to-have. You'll spend real time watching how the team works, spotting the recurring manual tasks, and building the automations and workflows that remove them. Nowhere else will you get this kind of head start on how AI is about to reshape marketing work.

We're hiring for this role in two flavors — pick whichever matches your situation:

  • Working student: 20h/week, ongoing

  • Intern: 3–6 months, full-time (with the option to convert to a permanent role)

Both cover the same scope and both start 01 September 2026, based hybrid out of our Munich office.

You won't be doing busywork. You'll cut the webinar clips that actually get watched, build the campaign assets that go live, help ship the case studies our sales team uses to close deals, and build the AI workflows that free up the whole team's time. You'll work directly with 7 people across the whole marketing team — so in a few months you'll have touched more of B2B SaaS marketing (and modern AI tooling) than most internships give you in a year.

If you're hungry, a fast learner, and want real mentorship instead of coffee runs, we'd love to hear from you!

👥 WHOM YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH

  • Mark, Head of Marketing

  • Isabela, Senior Content Engineer & Strategist

  • George, Demand Generation Lead

  • Cindy, Senior Product Marketing Manager

  • Iva, Senior Revenue Operations Manager (Marketing Ops)

  • Chris, Website Developer & Designer

  • Julie, Brand & Content Designer

  • Performance marketing agency

🎯 PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES

  • 🤖 AI & automation: observe the team's recurring, manual tasks and propose what's worth automating; build and ship real automations, workflows, and Claude skills and plugins the team actually uses; document and roll out new AI tooling once it works.

  • 🎙 Webinars & content: cut short clips from webinar recordings for LinkedIn, build Canva assets from existing templates, create CMS/on-demand entries for finished webinars, draft per-event email copy (invites, reminders, follow-ups) for review, draft social recap posts, and handle scheduling across the webinar calendar.

  • 📈 Field marketing & demand gen: campaign and list admin, processing event attendee lists, translation checks on ad assets (German), reporting & analytics support, and event prospect sourcing.

  • 🎨 Product marketing: supporting case studies and customer stories, producing sales enablement assets, product launch support, competitive research legwork, and keeping CMS entries updated and quality-checked.

💬 LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS

Fluency in German and English is a must. Our webinar program tilts US/UK, so your English needs to be excellent — German is needed for the DACH content stream and recap posts.

💡 SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, AND EXPERTISE

We purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. What matters most: you're currently studying (or recently graduated), curious about B2B/SaaS marketing, tech, and AI, and organized enough to juggle small recurring tasks across different stakeholders. No webinar or automation experience required — this is fully trainable, and being excited to get hands-on with tools like Claude, Canva, and our CMS Framer is a big plus. If you're interested in why we banned requirements from our job descriptions – see here: https://luminovo.com/resources/blog/why-we-banned-requirements-from-our-job-descriptions

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

See what employees and candidates have to say about Luminovo on kununu and Glassdoor.

  • Level 0.1 • Base Salary €1,392 – €2,650 per month
  • Level 0.2 • Base Salary €1,566 – €2,900 per month

We're looking for a commercially minded Finance Business Partner - Germany to help shape the financial future of our growing German business.

You'll partner closely with leaders across Germany and the wider Finance team to deliver meaningful insights, improve financial performance, and support strategic decision making. This is far more than producing reports, you'll influence business decisions, challenge assumptions, build robust financial models, and help ensure we're investing in the right opportunities.

As Germany continues to grow, you'll play a key role in establishing scalable financial planning processes while acting as a trusted business partner across multiple functions.

  • Play an active role in planning, forecasting and long-range planning for the German business.

You're naturally curious and enjoy digging into data to uncover the story behind the numbers. You're equally comfortable building detailed financial models as you are presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.

  • Significant experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Commercial Finance or Strategic Finance.

📝 Contract type: Permanent, full time

💬 Language Requirements: German and English business fluent

Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. Tax advisory is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI is now enabling a fundamental shift and there are no playbooks yet. We're writing them.

We are a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company, and the former Klarna Head of Engineering.



About the role

As Entrepreneur in Residence for the healthcare sector in our tax rollup, you will be responsible for Taxforce's core vertical, the medical sector. You will be building the best-in-class tax advisory product for the ambulatory healthcare sector and owning the business behind it. At the core, this is a product role: you'll take the pain points and needs of doctors and MVZ operators and turn them into a systematic, scalable product, built in close collaboration with our tax ops and tech teams. As the vertical matures, you'll take full ownership of the unit, including sales, P&L, and partnerships, and grow into the leader who scales it into a standalone business.

This role is built for someone who has founded a company before, or who wants to one day. You'll get founder-level scope and responsibility from day one, with the backing of an experienced team.

What you'll do

  • Define what a best-in-class tax advisory experience looks like for the ambulatory healthcare sector by converting the needs and pain points of doctors and MVZ operators into a systematic, scalable tax advisory product

  • Report directly to the founders and contribute to company-wide strategy

Who you are

  • You've founded a company before, or you're building toward founding your own one day, and you want founder-level ownership now

  • You can translate messy, real-world customer problems into a clear, scalable product

  • You're comfortable owning commercial outcomes: sales, P&L, partnerships, not just the product itself

  • Ideally, you have existing relationships or credibility within medical practices, MVZ, or the healthcare procurement world

  • You want to lead. You're energized by the idea of building and eventually running a full business unit, not just contributing to one

What we offer

  • Gain entrepreneurial experience: build a company within a company, with full ownership of product, sales, and P&L

  • Work with the founders: direct access to a team with Goldman Sachs, HBS, Bain, and Klarna backgrounds

  • AI at the core: see how AI transforms a traditional industry, and actively shape the product

  • Steep learning curve: real problems, fast feedback, and the experience to lead, or start, your own venture

description_html:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank group, we are adding a layer of resources and expertise to benefit from, while continuing to operate as an independent fintech company with our own team, product, and start-up identity under the dwpbank umbrella.

Your Mission:

As a Founder’s Associate Intern, you will support the leadership team here at lemon.markets, making sure the business grows and runs smoothly, ensuring alignment across all business areas.

You will work with different teams on a selection of diverse projects, ranging from Strategy and Operations to BizDev and GTM and more. These projects can be hard to forecast and will highly depend on needs evolving from the phase lemon.markets is in, as well as hugely on your interests and the skill set you already bring along or want to learn.

You will get the best of both worlds: Experience first-hand how a start-up is being built, enjoy and benefit from a fast-paced and flexible environment, while working closely with experienced experts in their field. That means you will not only support and leverage your skill set, but learn and grow by taking on projects with a high degree of ownership.

You will:

  • Support our leadership team on strategic projects by helping develop and execute business strategies and ensuring alignment with our company goals and objectives.

  • Help define and develop our GTM strategy by researching market trends, analysing competitors and their activities, and staying up to date with the evolving brokerage landscape in Europe.

  • Drive strategic initiatives across teams as we scale our business operations and strengthen the partner experience post launch.

  • Critically assess, analyse, and improve existing processes, helping us build scalable processes that enable the organisation to run smoothly and support our continued growth.

Who are you:

  • You have a background in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Computer science or a related field.

  • You are an entrepreneurial and analytical problem solver who combines structured and critical thinking with a high degree of ownership and independence.

  • You have gained hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment. You understand what working in an early-stage startup looks like. Alternatively, you have worked in consulting, venture capital, tech or similar roles before.

  • You take ownership, identify problems proactively, challenge the status quo, and manage ambiguity and changing priorities effectively.

  • You have a hands-on and iterative mindset: you act quickly, learn from first results, and continuously improve your work across changing tasks and requirements.

  • You are a collaborative team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and learning new tools and skills.

  • You are fluent or a native German speaker (this is a mandatory requirement). You also have strong written and verbal English skills.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: Our Interns are compensated at a fixed rate of €2,425 per month.

  • 💎 Make a real impact: Our start-up environment gives you the opportunity to start your career, explore areas outside your role, and build expertise through ownership. As we mature and are backed by dwpbank, we’re adding additional resources and expertise that you can benefit from.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9-to-5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from Berlin within a hybrid model. However, we strongly encourage our internship “lemoneers” to spend at least 4 days or more per week in the office. Being on-site allows you to learn faster, provides a more immersive experience, helps you collaborate more effectively with the team, and ensures you fully benefit from hands-on support.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, plus a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations so you always know where you stand, and what to do to level up.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day, Friday food market strolls at Maybachufer, and our monthly new-joiner breakfast. But also in the bigger things: celebrating the onboarding of new partners, growing our teams, and owning a strong discussion culture.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. title: Product Marketing Manager (Robotics & Automation)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at RobCo
description_html:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

The Role

RobCo goes to market across three streams: Alfie (our emerging, headline-making Physical AI product), Embedded Robotics, and Integrated Solutions. This role owns product marketing for the latter two — together the backbone of RobCo's current business. Embedded Robotics is our single largest source of net-new revenue today; Integrated Solutions is our large-deal, high-touch offering, often but not exclusively delivered together with partners.

This is a depth role. You'll get genuinely close to customers and verticals - automotive, food & beverage, electronics, plastics, and more - and turn that understanding into the content and enablement material that helps Sales (and our partners) actually close. RobCo already has a growing library of real deployments with measurable results; a large part of this role is turning that raw material into whitepapers, case studies, and video content people actually use.

Longer term, you'll help lay the groundwork for RobCoMMUNITY - the network of engaged customers and champions we're building across Embedded and Integrated. Finding and nurturing the customers willing to go public with their story is as much a part of this role as writing the story itself.

Your Responsibilities

1. Sales Enablement for Embedded Robotics & Integrated Solutions

  • Own enablement materials — pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling — for both streams.

  • Integrated Solutions skews heavily toward partner-led deals — build materials that equip our partner network, not just our direct sellers.

2. Customer & Vertical Understanding

  • Build and maintain vertical-specific messaging and use-case libraries — automotive, food & beverage, electronics, plastics, and beyond.

  • Talk regularly to customers, Sales, and Solutions Engineering so messaging stays grounded in what's actually being deployed, not just what's on the roadmap.

3. Content Creation, at Volume

  • Own whitepapers, case studies, and video content end-to-end — turning real deployments into content Sales can actually use in a deal.

  • Keep the case study and reference library current as new proof points land — this is a living library, not a one-time project.

4. RobCoMMUNITY (Long-Term)

  • Help lay the groundwork for RobCoMMUNITY across our customer landscape.

  • Identify and nurture reference customers willing to go public - case studies, testimonials, events.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • 3–5 years in Product Marketing, Content Marketing, or Customer Marketing - B2B; industrial or technical experience is a strong plus.

  • Strong, proven writing skills - comfortable owning a whitepaper or case study from a rough customer conversation through to a finished, polished piece.

  • Genuine curiosity about customers - comfortable interviewing a customer and turning their story into content that sells.

  • Organized to keep a growing content library current - this role is as much about maintenance as creation.

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong plus.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in industrial, manufacturing, robotics, or adjacent B2B tech.

  • Experience supporting sales motions.

  • Video content coordination experience.

  • Familiarity with content workflows.

Why Join RobCo

The category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics is being defined right now, and our partner ecosystem is one of the key levers for how we scale across Europe and into the US. As the first person in this function, you will have a rare combination of strategic ownership and direct impact - building something from scratch that will matter at company scale.

  • Own a function end-to-end from day one, with direct access to senior leadership

  • Work at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships in a company at a category-defining moment

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

  • Develop the core messaging and positioning for Alfie - value props, differentiators, use cases - and own the framework that Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and External Comms all draw from.

  • Own the RobCoN messaging framework and speaker briefing materials, and help shape how the live stage moments land.

  • This is a high-visibility, high-stakes mandate: the work you ship here will be seen by the entire company, our customers, and the market, at the most important moment in RobCo's history so far.

We're Looking for Someone Who Has

  • 6+ years of relevant experience - this can be Product Marketing, but just as easily Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering, Applications Engineering, Technical Consulting, Product Management, or a hands-on role in robotics, automation, or industrial tech. description_html:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our Senior Full Stack Engineer, Agentic Workflows (m/f/d), you'll build the agentic workflows that run our solution delivery behind the scenes. Every customer project produces requirements, designs, plans, and checks on the way from a customer's problem to a robot running on their factory floor. Your agents will work at each of these steps: reviewing requirements before they become commitments, checking and improving artifacts as the project moves, and catching risks while there's still time to act on them. You'll build the first agentic workflows, the reusable components and governance they run on, and much of how RobCo uses AI internally.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and run agentic workflows across our delivery process - requirements review, automated checks and gates, early risk detection, and a knowledge base that makes everything we've learned from past projects available to agents and people - owning each from concept through production.

  • Build the way we build: reusable components, skills, and patterns for tool integrations, feedback loops, and identity, secret, and auth management. You know the agentic toolbox inside out and decide what we actually need and what we don't.

  • Own quality end to end: design and run evals, monitor agents in production, and manage observability, cost, guardrails, and security so teams can trust what the agents produce.

  • Design human-in-the-loop workflows that learn: people review and correct agent output at defined checkpoints, and those corrections flow back into better prompts, evals, and components, so the agents keep improving.

  • Embed with our delivery teams to understand how their work actually flows, identify where agents create the most leverage, and define together what good looks like.

  • Drive adoption and help shape how RobCo uses AI internally: deliver agents through the tools teams already use every day, establish best practices, and build paved paths so teams can eventually create their own agents.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Several years of software engineering experience and the seniority to take a problem from ambiguous idea to production system, with clean architecture, solid testing, and maintainable code.

  • Shipped LLM-powered or agentic systems that real users depend on, not just prototypes: tool calling, structured outputs, multi-step workflows. Deep, practical experience with the agentic stack — orchestration, tool use, MCP, memory, and retrieval — in production environments.

  • Strong context engineering and prompt engineering skills: you think carefully about what the model sees and in what structure, you treat prompts as versioned, tested engineering artifacts, and you have a rigorous way of judging whether the output is actually good.

  • Execute deep statistical analyses, calculating MTBF/MTTF for random failures and L10/B10 wear-out life for bearings, gears, and brakes while defending underlying assumptions.

  • Evaluate data integrity with sharp engineering judgment, knowing precisely when data is decision-grade versus a placeholder to guide leadership decisions.

  • Completed vocational training or a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, or comparable experience.

  • Several years of experience in reliability engineering focused on complex electro/mechanical products.

  • Strong ownership and growth mindset, pragmatic working style and analytical rigor to reach defensible conclusions from incomplete evidence.

  • Very good English skills (German is a plus).

  • Practical command of RBD modeling, MTBF/MTTF prediction, L10/B10 life calculation, and hands-on FMEA/FMEDA experience.

  • Background in robotics, industrial automation, automotive, aerospace, or medical devices.

title: Accountant (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at RobCo
description_html:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

In dieser Schlüsselrolle bist du eine tragende Säule unseres Finance team und sorgst für finanzielle Präzision, Compliance und Skalierbarkeit. Dein Fokus liegt nicht nur auf der Aufrechterhaltung des Status quo, sondern darauf, eine hocheffiziente, automatisierte und moderne Buchhaltungslandschaft mitzugestalten, die mit unserem globalen Wachstum Schritt hält.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die laufende Kreditorenbuchhaltung, von der Rechnungsprüfung über die Kontierung bis zur fristgerechten Zahlung.

  • Du verantwortest die laufende Debitorenbuchhaltung, inklusive Rechnungsstellung, Zahlungseingangsüberwachung und Mahnwesen.

  • Du führst die Inventur der Warenbestände durch, insbesondere der unfertigen Erzeugnisse, als Grundlage für die Ermittlung der Gesamtleistung.

  • Du unterstützt bei allen operativen Tätigkeiten, die der Accounting Lead zur Erstellung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen benötigt.

  • Du klärst offene Posten und stimmst Konten im Kreditoren- und Debitorenbereich ab.

  • Du bereitest Unterlagen für Steuerberater und Wirtschaftsprüfer mit vor.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Accounting Lead zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen zur Prozessverbesserung ein.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Buchhalter/-in,

    Steuerfachangestellte/r, Industriekaufmann/-frau oder vergleichbar); eine

    Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Kreditoren- und/oder Debitorenbuchhaltung.

  • Erfahrung mit Inventurprozessen und Warenbestandsbewertung, idealerweise auch

    bei unfertigen Erzeugnissen, ist ein Plus.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit gängiger Buchhaltungssoftware bzw. ERP, idealerweise DATEV,

    Odoo, Ramp oder MOSS.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Sorgfältige, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise und Teamgeist.

Warum RobCo?

  • Entwickle mit uns modulare, softwaredefinierte Robotiklösungen, die neue Maßstäbe in der Automatisierung setzen.

  • Hilf uns dabei, Roboter zu bauen, die mit modernster KI ausgestattet sind, ihre Umgebung wahrnehmen, Daten analysieren und in Echtzeit intelligente Entscheidungen treffen.

  • Als Teil eines sehr dynamischen und schnell wachsenden Scale-ups übernimmst du vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung, treibst deine eigenen Projekte voran und siehst den direkten Einfluss deiner Arbeit.

  • Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation und regelmäßiges 360°-Feedback ermöglichen schnelle Entscheidungen und unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

  • Eine geförderte Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft (über 7.200 Studios in ganz Deutschland).

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, ein modernes Büro und – je nach Funktion – die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents – von entspannten Bier- & Pizza-Abenden auf der Dachterrasse bis hin zu gemeinsamen Erlebnissen bei Skiausflügen oder auf dem Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: Senior Partner Marketing Manager (m/f/d)

description_html:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

The Role

As our first Senior Partner Marketing Manager, you will build the partner marketing function from scratch - co-defining the strategy with our VP of Marketing and owning the execution end-to-end. This is not a role where you hand off to someone else to implement. You design it, you build it, and you run it. If you need someone else to execute for you, this is not the right role. If you thrive on building something that doesn't exist yet, it might be exactly what you're looking for.

Your Responsibilities

Partner Marketing Strategy

  • Co-develop and continuously refine RobCo's global partner marketing strategy together with the VP of Marketing and our Global Partner Director aligned with the partner tier structure owned by the Partner Management team

  • Define a differentiated marketing approach per partner tier - Tier 1 partners receive a full co-marketing program; Tier 2 and Tier 3 partners receive scaled, asset-led support

  • Translate the overall partner strategy into a concrete, executable marketing plan with clear milestones and KPIs

Partner Marketing Infrastructure & Tracking

  • Build the infrastructure for partner marketing from the ground up: processes, templates, tracking mechanisms, and reporting frameworks

  • Own the tracking of all partner marketing activities and their contribution to pipeline and revenue

  • Develop and maintain a clear view of partner marketing performance across the ecosystem

Partner Marketing Guidelines, Content & Assets

  • Develop partner marketing guidelines that ensure consistent positioning and messaging in line with RobCo's category leadership in Autonomous Industrial Robotics

  • Create and manage co-marketing assets, content, and campaigns in close collaboration with partners - in both German and English depending on the partner

  • Equip partners with the materials they need to go to market effectively on RobCo's behalf

Networking & Relationship Ownership

  • Own the marketing relationship with partners across all tiers - from large international system integrators to smaller traditional German industrial firms

  • Build strong working relationships directly with partner contacts, including partners who work exclusively in German

  • Represent RobCo at partner events, industry meetups, and co-marketing activations

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Global Partner Director and Partner Managers (Munich-based, with US expansion underway) to align marketing activities with partnership priorities and deal flow

  • Collaborate with the broader Marketing team on messaging, content, and campaign integration

  • Feed partner insights back into Marketing and Product to inform positioning and roadmap

We're Looking for Someone Who Has

  • 4 - 6 years of experience in Partner Marketing, Channel Marketing, or a closely related B2B marketing role - ideally in a tech, SaaS, or industrial environment

  • Proven experience building partner marketing programs, not just running them within an existing structure

  • A strategic mindset combined with a strong hands-on execution drive - you are equally comfortable in a workshop defining strategy and in a spreadsheet tracking campaign performance

  • Strong relationship skills across a diverse partner base - from global tech companies to small traditional German industrial firms

  • Fluent in both German and English - you will work in both languages daily, and some of our most important partners work exclusively in German

  • Experience with co-marketing, joint campaigns, and partner enablement materials

  • A genuine interest in AI and how it applies to your own work - we actively use AI tools to move faster and expect our team to do the same

  • Bonus: familiarity with the industrial automation, robotics, or Physical AI space

Why Join RobCo

The category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics is being defined right now, and our partner ecosystem is one of the key levers for how we scale across Europe and into the US. As the first person in this function, you will have a rare combination of strategic ownership and direct impact - building something from scratch that will matter at company scale.

  • Own a function end-to-end from day one, with direct access to senior leadership

  • Work at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships in a company at a category-defining moment

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Your Responsibilities

  • Integration & Interfaces: You integrate complex peripheral devices and interfaces (e.g., cameras, measurement and testing systems, controllers, ERP systems) into our robot cells for our customer projects.   • You have experience in integrating and controlling industrial equipment, ideally within an automation or robotics environment.

  • You find creative solutions where others give up, think in systems, have a hands-on mentality, and do not get caught up in theory.

  • You actively seek collaboration in cross-functional teams across departmental boundaries and gladly take on an interface role between different stakeholders.

  • You are open to on-site customer visits and find it exciting to deploy software in real-world environments.

  • You bring a passion for pragmatic and efficient problem-solving, a desire for pioneering work, and the drive to genuinely make things work.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

title: Founding Talent Lead (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Cortea AI
description_html:
About Cortea

We’re Cortea, a Berlin startup transforming audits with AI. Manual, document-heavy audits waste expert time while demand keeps rising. Our AI-powered software and specialized AI agents remove the repetitive work so auditors can focus on judgment.

Backed by top-tier VCs with >15m funding, with a working product and paying customers, we’re rapidly scaling.

We value first-principles thinking, speed, trust, and kindness. We build side by side in our Berlin office.

The Role

You build talent foundations. You’ll design a process, that bring in exceptional talent across Tech and Non-Tech, and build a culture we’re proud of.

What you’ll do

  • Own the Talent end to end: job design → scope → JD → sourcing → structured interviews → offer → close

  • Build a Talent Engine: attract great people proactively; both inbound and outbound

  • Raise the hiring bar: scorecards, trained interviewers, consistent candidate experience

  • Shape our brand for Tech/AI talent with content, events, and a strong referral loop

  • Be culture-positive: partner with founders on rituals, onboarding handover, and feedback loops

You’ll be great at this if you

  • Have 5+ years of TA in a fast environment (startup/scale-up or agency)

  • Have hired top talent before and know the difference in how to assess them

  • Communicate clearly, leverage our founding team, and make data driven decisions fast

  • Can show early-stage track record you’re proud of

  • Think in systems and improve with data; bonus if you’ve built employer branding for engineers/AI

How we work

  • We value kindness + candor + execution, speed with care, and strong ownership

  • We’re fully in-office in Berlin because we like building side by side

  • We hire with structured interviews and clear scorecards to reduce bias

  • Non-linear paths welcome. Career breaks welcome. If you’re unsure, apply.

What we offer

  • High impact from day one and a path to Head of Talent/People as we grow

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity (range shared on the first call)

  • In-office energy. shared lunches, whiteboard time, fast decisions, real teamwork

  • Uncapped growth. Budget for tools, learning, and events you choose

Interview process

  • Intro Call (25 min) with Liza

  • Expert interview (45 min): with Valentin (Co-Founder) - deep dive into: sourcing strategy, process design, quality in decisions)

  • Cultural interview (45 min): with Philipp (Co-Founder) - collaboration, judgment, and culture add

  • On-site day (Berlin): meet the team and work on a real life assignment

title: AI Product Manager (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Cortea AI
description_html:
About us

Cortea is building the quality layer for AI-powered audits.

Our Audit Quality Agents help audit firms use AI with greater trust, consistency, and professional oversight. Built around auditing standards and review workflows, they enable firms to deliver more reliable and reviewable work while increasing capacity across the audit process.

We're building an AI-native company from day one. We believe small teams, equipped with AI and empowered to move fast, can solve some of the biggest challenges facing the audit profession.

Your Role

As an AI Product Manager, you'll work on products in our AI audit toolbox alongside engineers, designers, auditors and our founders. You'll spend your time understanding what auditors need, helping shape what we build next, and making sure we ship things that actually solve real problems.

What you'll do

  • Contribute to the discovery, definition, and delivery of products in our AI toolbox

  • Talk to customers weekly to uncover pain points and validate solutions

  • Prototype with AI tools (Cursor, Claude, v0, etc.) to test ideas in hours, instead of weeks

  • Work tightly with engineering and design throughout the build cycle

  • Help us understand the messy reality of AI capabilities (and limits) and turn that into product decisions: what's worth building, what's not yet ready, where humans stay in the loop

  • Bring structure to the problem space: clear writing, sharp questions, useful PRDs

What success looks like

  • You've contributed to and shipped 3+ meaningful product bets within your first 6 months, learning through iteration and customer feedback along the way.

  • You've gone deep on at least one core product area (e.g. a specific tool in our AI toolbox, a customer segment, our evals & quality framework, or the UX of agentic workflows) and become exceptionally strong in it

  • You're trusted by founders, engineers, and customers to steward important product decisions

Who you are

  • Have 4–7 years of experience, with at least 2 years in a product role

  • Have shipped B2B SaaS products that real customers pay for and use

  • Are AI-native in how you work: you use LLMs, agents, and AI tooling daily and have strong intuition for what they can and can't do today

  • Have shipped at least one AI-powered feature or product and understand the unique product challenges (evals, latency, hallucinations, trust, UX of probabilistic systems)

  • Go deep into context to truly understand user problems

  • Are comfortable in early-stage startup chaos. High autonomy, high ambiguity, high speed

Bonus points

  • You've founded a company or shipped a serious AI side project

  • You can read code, run small scripts, or fine-tune prompts yourself

  • Experience in audit, compliance, legal, or another document-heavy professional services domain

What We Offer

  • High impact & growth: Front-row seat to a fast-scaling AI startup, with the chance to grow alongside the product

  • Mission-driven culture: First-principles thinking, bold ideas, and a supportive team

  • Attractive compensation: competitive salary + meaningful equity

  • Personal development: Learning budget for courses and conferences

  • Dynamic environment: Central Berlin office, team lunches, retreats, flexible vacation

Interview process

  • First Call: Intro to Cortea with our Founders Associate Liza

  • Second Call: Product deep-dive with our Co-Founder & CPO Philipp

  • Third Call: Deep dive into our culture with our Co-Founder & CEO Valentin

  • On-site Day (Berlin): Meet the team and work on a real problem together

description_html:
About us

We’re Cortea, a Berlin-based startup rebuilding how audits are done.

Audits are still driven by spreadsheets, checklists, and manual reviews in one of the most regulated, high-stakes areas of business. We use AI to automate audits end to end, so highly educated auditors no longer spend 60+ hour weeks on manual work and can focus on judgment, trust, and choices that matter.

With €15m+ in funding, a live product, and paying customers across Europe, we’re at a stage where your choices will directly shape Cortea’s future, and how audits are done.

 

The role

This isn't an administrative or "assistant" role. As Chief of Staff, you are a core member of the leadership orbit. You will work directly with Valentin (Co-Founder) to translate high-level vision into operational reality.

You will sit at the intersection of Growth, Strategy, Finance, and Operations. Your mission is to tackle the most complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t yet have a home, whether that’s architecting our international expansion, refining our AI-driven unit economics, or managing the machinery of a Series B fundraise.

This role is a springboard. You will gain a "CEO-level" view of building a category-defining AI company.

 

What you’ll do

  • Strategic Initiatives: Lead high-impact projects from conception to completion (e.g., designing an AI-era pricing model, spearheading entry into new European markets, or optimizing the sales-to-onboarding funnel).

  • Fundraising & IR: Act as the primary engine behind investor relations and future funding rounds, preparing the narratives and data rooms that will fuel Cortea’s growth.

  • Scaling the AI-Native Operating System: Build the repeatable processes, meeting cadences, and communication loops — supercharged with AI agents and automation — that allow Cortea to scale toward €100m+ ARR without losing speed. You'll treat internal workflows as products, deploying AI wherever it removes friction.

  • Founder Force Multiplier: Act as a proxy for the founders in internal and external meetings, ensuring decisions are made and projects stay on track even when the founders aren't in the room.

     

Who you are

  • 4+ years of experience in high-velocity environments (Top-tier Strategy Consulting, Investment Banking, or a high-growth VC-backed startup).

  • Strategic Operator: You can think at 30,000 feet about market positioning, but you have the grit to dive into a spreadsheet or a legal contract to get a deal over the line.

  • Financial Fluency: You have a deep understanding of P&L management, financial modeling, and SaaS metrics.

  • Exceptional Communicator: You can distill complex AI concepts and financial data into clear, persuasive narratives for investors and the team.

  • High Agency: You don’t wait for a playbook; you write it. You are comfortable with the ambiguity of a "zero-to-one" environment.

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in both English and German (C1+) is essential for this Berlin-based role.

 

How we work

  • Founder mindset: Everyone acts like a founder. You’re encouraged to take on any topic you believe is worth improving, with team and founder support.

  • Thoughtful decision-making: Collaborative problem solving, concise written thinking, and deep in-person discussions to reach the best result.

  • Speed over perfection: We value progress and learning, preferring strong 80/20 solutions over perfection.

  • Feedback & learning: We give and ask for feedback weekly. Not monthly.

 

What success looks like

  • In 3 months: You have worked through our ops, deployed workflow automations across the company, and offloaded 20% of the founders' highest-priority tasks.

  • In 6 months: You have led at least one major cross-functional launch (e.g., a new country or a major pricing pivot) and are the go-to person for our lead investors.

  • In 12 months: You have helped institutionalize the "Cortea Way," creating a scalable operational foundation that supports our next major funding milestone.

 

What we offer

  • Impact: A seat at the table during the most critical growth phase of a well-funded AI startup.

  • Growth: Mentorship from experienced founders and close collaboration across the company

  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.

  • Perks: Learning budget, team lunches, off-sites, flexible vacation, and a supportive in-office setup in central Berlin

     

Interview process

  • Intro call with Liza (Founders Associate)

  • Strategy & finance interview, real-world scenario with Valentin (Co-Founder)

  • Culture interview, Values and Collaboration Fit with Philipp (Co-Founder)

  • On-site day (Berlin): meet the team and work through a real, current problem

We’re an equal‑opportunity team and strongly encourage women and underrepresented candidates to apply.

title: Product Marketing & Content Lead (m/f/x)

description_html:
About Cortea

Cortea is building the quality layer for AI-powered audits.

Our Audit Quality Agents help audit firms use AI with greater trust, consistency, and professional oversight. Built around auditing standards and review workflows, they enable firms to deliver more reliable and reviewable work while increasing capacity across the audit process.

We're building an AI-native company from day one. We believe small teams, equipped with AI and empowered to move fast, can solve some of the biggest challenges facing the audit profession.

We're looking for our first Product Marketing & Content Lead to help define how the market understands Cortea, why firms adopt our products, and how we become the category-defining voice in AI-powered audit.

The role

This isn't a traditional marketing role.

As our first Product Marketing & Content Lead, you'll shape how the market understands Cortea and how our customers experience our products—from first impression to every product release.

You'll report directly to the VP Marketing and work closely with the founders, product, design, sales, and customer success teams. You'll have a seat at the table with the leadership team, helping shape our product narrative, go-to-market strategy, and category positioning.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys turning complex technology into simple, compelling stories. You'll own product positioning, messaging, launches, customer communications, thought leadership, and our content engine.

You'll have significant ownership from day one and the opportunity to build this function as Cortea grows.

What you'll do

Own product marketing

  • Develop and continuously refine Cortea's positioning, messaging, and category narrative.

  • Translate product capabilities into clear customer value propositions.

  • Lead product launches and feature releases across every customer touchpoint.

  • Own customer communications around product releases, including release notes, feature announcements, newsletters, and adoption campaigns.

  • Build competitive intelligence and market insights.

  • Develop customer personas and messaging frameworks.

  • Create sales enablement materials that help our commercial team win.

  • Partner closely with Product to ensure launches are coordinated and impactful.

Build the content engine

  • Own Cortea's content strategy across all channels.

  • Produce exceptional thought leadership on AI, auditing, regulation, quality, and the future of professional services.

  • Interview customers and industry experts to uncover unique stories and insights.

  • Write and edit everything from blog articles to research reports and customer stories.

  • Develop AI-powered content systems that scale without compromising quality.

  • Build and maintain an editorial calendar that compounds over time.

Shape the category

  • Help establish Cortea as the leading voice in AI-powered auditing.

  • Partner closely with the VP Marketing on category strategy and messaging.

  • Support executive thought leadership across the leadership team.

  • Identify emerging market trends and turn them into compelling narratives.

  • Build signature content that becomes a reference point for the industry.

Drive commercial impact

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to improve customer education and product adoption.

  • Support demand generation with high-quality product marketing assets.

  • Scale organic growth through content and SEO.

  • Measure the performance of launches, messaging, and content.

  • Continuously gather customer insights and bring them back into Product and Marketing.

What we're looking for

Must-have

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Content Marketing, or a similar B2B SaaS role.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills.

  • Experience launching products and translating technical capabilities into compelling customer narratives.

  • Strong understanding of product positioning and messaging.

  • Experience creating content that drives measurable business outcomes.

  • Excellent interviewing, research, and communication skills.

  • A highly proactive mindset with the ability to thrive in ambiguity.

  • Comfortable working directly with executives and cross-functional leadership teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in AI, enterprise software, or B2B SaaS.

  • Experience marketing products for professional services, finance, accounting, audit, or compliance.

  • Strong SEO knowledge.

  • Experience building founder or executive thought leadership.

  • Familiarity with modern AI tools and AI-native marketing workflows.

  • Experience building content operations and editorial processes.

You'll thrive here if you

  • Think like an owner.

  • Love understanding customers.

  • Care deeply about clear communication.

  • Enjoy simplifying complex ideas.

  • Prefer building over managing.

  • Are naturally curious and ask great questions.

  • Like working across Product, Sales, and Marketing.

  • Want to help define a new category—not just market another software product.

What success looks like

Within your first year:

  • Cortea has a clear and differentiated product narrative.

  • Every product launch has a repeatable go-to-market process.

  • Customers consistently understand the value of new capabilities.

  • Cortea is recognized as one of the leading voices in AI-powered audit.

  • Our content engine generates meaningful awareness, engagement, and pipeline.

  • Product Marketing becomes a core strategic function within the company.

Why join Cortea

  • Build one of Europe's most ambitious AI companies from an early stage.

  • Report directly to the VP Marketing and work closely with the founders and leadership team.

  • Own an entire function from day one.

  • Help define the future of AI in one of the world's largest professional services industries.

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.

  • Work with a small, ambitious team that believes in moving fast, thinking independently, and using AI to do the best work of their careers.

Don't meet every requirement?

We know great candidates don't always check every box.

If you're excited about the role, passionate about storytelling, product marketing, and AI, and believe you can help shape the future of audit, we'd love to hear from you.

Show us something you've created that changed how people think.
